### [1] [Instability Floors: Separating Bias from Noise in Fairness Audits of Clinical LLM Agents with FairMedAgent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.03221)
*Rohith Reddy Bellibatlu,Manpreet Singh,Deepak Parashar,Rahul Joshi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出临床语言模型代理的反事实公平性审计中，flip rate（翻转率）受到采样随机性引起的"零变化波动"（floor）的严重干扰，必须先量化并扣除该 floor，才能正确解读人口统计学效应。作者通过 16 个合成临床场景在 6 个模型（5 家供应商）上的实验，提出了四项报告规范，并开源了 FairMedAgent 评测工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前临床语言模型代理的反事实公平性审计以"翻转率"为核心指标，即仅改变患者人口学描述时模型行为变化的频率。然而，随机性（即非确定的）在相同输入下也会产生行为波动，导致翻转率天然包含非人口统计学成分。已有审计普遍未对该随机性基线（floor）进行量化或扣除，使得人口统计学公平性的解读不可靠。

Method: 1. 设计 16 个合成临床小场景（vignettes），覆盖重症升级、管制药物谨慎等典型任务；2. 在 6 个模型（5 家供应商，含本地部署与托管模型）上对每个条件重复运行 10 次以量化采样随机性；3. 计算"零变化时"行动不一致的配对比例作为 floor；4. 评估多数投票（5 票）与温度（T=0）对 floor 的削减效果；5. 推导翻转率与 floor 的理论关系——二元动作下无人口学效应时翻转率等于 floor，实际效应仅按平方叠加；6. 提出有符号配对需求和四项报告流程；7. 开源 FairMedAgent 评测工具（包含协议、场景与分析脚本）。

Result: - 默认采样下，临床代理在 10 次重复 ×16 场景中，零变化配对行动不一致率达 8.7%；- 任务间差异显著：重症升级仅 2.2%，管制药物谨慎高达 17.9%（后者无明确操作标准）；- 6 个模型池化 floor 范围为 2.5%–23.7%，模型规模、供应商、托管方式均不能预测 floor 大小；- 5 次采样的多数投票可去除 39% 的 floor（95% CI 18–64）；- 温度为 0 时，本地 4 个模型中有 3 个不再出现不一致，但某托管模型仍存在不一致；- 理论推导证明：翻转率 ≤ floor 不构成公平证据，方向性须用有符号配对需求验证。

Conclusion: 临床语言模型反事实公平审计必须先测量并报告采样随机性 floor，否则翻转率无法解读；多数投票和温度 0 可显著但非完全消除 floor；公平性判断需使用有符号配对需求；作者提出四项报告步骤并开源 FairMedAgent，使任何团队都能为其代理量化 floor。

Abstract: Counterfactual fairness audits of clinical language-model agents report a flip rate: how often an action changes when only the patient's demographic descriptor changes. Part of that rate is not demographic. A stochastic agent also changes its own action when nothing changes, and a flip rate cannot be interpreted without knowing how often. We measured it. Re-running one condition ten times over sixteen synthetic vignettes at default sampling changed a clinical agent's action in 8.7 percent of replicate pairs, from 2.2 percent for intensive-care escalation to 17.9 percent for controlled-substance caution, an output given no operational criteria. Across six models from five vendors, pooled floors ranged from 2.5 to 23.7 percent; in this panel neither disclosed size, vendor, nor hosting ordered them. The floor depends on the decoding configuration: majority voting over five draws removed 39 percent of it (95 percent confidence interval (CI) 18 to 64); at temperature 0 three of four locally served models showed no disagreement, but a hosted model still did. We also show that, for a binary action, the flip rate expected under no demographic effect equals the floor and a real effect adds only its square, so a flip rate inside the floor is not evidence of fairness, and direction must be tested with a signed paired test. We give a four-step reporting procedure and release FairMedAgent, the harness, with its protocol, vignettes and analysis scripts, so any team can measure the floor for its own agent.

</details>


### [2] [Automatic estimation of verbal fluency index in people with Motor Neuron Disease using ASR alignment and pause modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38203)
*Bahman Mirheidari,Leslie Ing,Daniel Blackburn,Sharon Abrahams,Christopher McDermott,Heidi Christensen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于WhisperX ASR与Silero VAD结合的自动言语流畅性指数(VFI)估计管道,用于运动神经元病(MND)患者的认知障碍监测。该系统仅利用言语流畅性生成阶段,通过精细化时间戳和临床可解释特征实现自动化评分,在P-words任务上R²达0.856,S-words任务上R²达0.832。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运动神经元病(MND)患者中高达50%会出现认知障碍,但由于伴随的构音障碍(dysarthria),传统认知评估面临挑战。ECAS量表中的言语流畅性指数(VFI)通过语速校正来区分运动功能与认知功能障碍,但其计算耗时且需要临床医生监督,亟需自动化方案以支持远程评估和大规模筛查。现有研究尚未专门针对MND人群的ECAS VFI自动估计。

Method: 提出四阶段自动VFI评分管道:1)使用WhisperX进行转录并获取词级时间戳;2)结合Silero VAD调整时间戳(采用Longest-Segment策略解决多VAD段对应单个ASR段的问题);3)临床特征提取器使用SpaCy和NLTK识别正确词汇(去除专有名词、重复、犹豫词),提取正确词数、平均词长、停顿比例等31个临床可解释特征;4)使用LASSO和SVR等回归模型估计VFI。数据集包含42名MND参与者(20名构音障碍、22名典型语音),采用5折交叉验证评估。

Result: 该方法显著优于基于传统声学特征(eGeMAPS等)和自监督嵌入(Wav2Vec2、HuBERT)的方法。最佳结果:P-words LASSO模型R²=0.856,NRMSE=0.053;S-words LASSO模型R²=0.832,NRMSE=0.083。临床自动特征(Clin-Auto)与临床手动特征(Clin-Man)性能无统计学显著差异,表明仅凭生成阶段即可可靠估计VFI。构音障碍患者估计误差较大(P-words NRMSE:典型0.05 vs dysarthric 0.117),但总体泛化良好。

Conclusion: 研究证实了集成先进ASR和VAD与可解释临床特征的自动管道生成准确VFI回归模型的可行性。仅使用生成阶段即可完成估计,无需控制性阅读阶段,从而减轻患者和临床医生负担。未来工作应纳入补充任务(阅读段落、图片描述)以更好地服务构音障碍人群。

Abstract: Monitoring cognitive impairment (CI) in motor neuron disease (MND) is essential for timely treatment and care, yet challenging due to co-occurring speech difficulties. The Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS) provides a robust metric for CI assessment, with the Verbal Fluency Index (VFI) a central element. Building on recent advances in automated speech analysis, this study proposes a system for estimating VFI. It leverages a unique MND dataset and combines ASR (WhisperX) and VAD (Silero) with refined timestamping to predict the VFI and extract several clinically interpretable measures. Our approach outperformed systems based on traditional acoustic features and self-supervised embeddings, evaluated using multiple regression algorithms. Clinically inspired features consistently outperformed the other sets, with the best models achieving strong results (P-words: R2 0.9, NRMSE 0.05; S-words: R2 0.8, NRMSE 0.08), demonstrating the feasibility of automated VFI estimation.

</details>


### [3] [ContextAdapt: Evaluating Contextual Adaptation and Value Alignment in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38260)
*Olivia Macmillan-Scott,Mirco Musolesi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ContextAdapt评估框架,用于评估大语言模型在不同职业情境下能否恰当调整抽象价值观(诚实、自主、保密)的应用方式,同时在情境变化不改变职业规范时保持一致性。通过构建基于一手专业文献的价值×领域矩阵,对12个LLM进行主实验和因子实验,发现模型平均恰当性高达95.6%,但在专业依据使用上差异显著(25.6%–76.9%);领域标签和角色变化影响有限,但"风险高低"操控引发了严重但局部的失败,严重程度充当了披露行为的线索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI对齐研究多关注模型在抽象原则上是否一致,而忽视了同一价值在不同职业情境下应有不同的行为操作化方式。例如医疗中的诚实允许治疗特权例外,法律中的诚实以法庭为先。如何评估模型能否识别情境中哪些维度与规范相关、哪些无关,是价值对齐评估的关键缺口。

Method: 构建ContextAdapt框架:(1)基于24份一手专业文献建立价值(诚实、自主、保密)×领域(医疗、法律、金融、国家安全)的参考规范矩阵;(2)从领域无关模板派生场景,测试默认规则与例外(含充分证据、证据不足、边界模糊三类探针);(3)评估12个LLM,主数据集107个场景测恰当性,辅数据集144个场景做因子操控(领域标签显隐性、决策者vs顾问角色、高低风险);(4)采用三位LLM评判员(GPT-5.6 Luna、Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、Command A)从行为恰当性与陈述依据两个维度编码,各模型每场景采样10次。

Result: 主实验:12模型平均恰当性95.6%(范围90.7%–99.4%),但正确领域特定依据使用率差异巨大(25.6%–76.9%),不存在按模型规模或训练方法的简单排序;Claude Sonnet 5(97.9%)最高,Command A(91.4%)与Llama 3.1 8B(90.8%)较低。辅实验:显性领域标签影响有限(86.2% vs 85.4%),角色影响小(86.8% vs 84.9%),但风险高低引发显著异质效应(90.7% vs 80.8%);最显著失败为Llama 3.1 70B在医疗×诚实上(100%高风险 vs 8.8%低风险),以及机构导向的国家安全保密(88.5% vs 10.1%);模式表明感知严重程度充当了披露线索。例外探针中欠触发(4.0%)略多于过触发(1.5%)。

Conclusion: 研究提出"校准的情境适应性"(calibrated contextual adaptation)概念:模型应在情境改变规范时调整行为,在规范不变时保持稳定。结论表明:(1)平均恰当性高不代表稳健价值学习,需同时评估行为恰当性与专业依据;(2)上下文敏感性不等于价值对齐,需识别哪些情境维度与规范相关;(3)基于原则的对齐方法(如Constitutional AI)需要更丰富的角色、目标、阈值、例外规范,或模型能可靠地从情境中推断这些结构;(4)评估抽象价值须追问模型是否知道何时该原则应导致不同行动。

Abstract: Values such as honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality are often regarded as general principles underpinning AI alignment. However, what it means to act in accordance with these values can depend on the context in which a decision is made. In this paper, we ask whether large language models (LLMs) appropriately adapt the application of a value across professional settings, while remaining consistent when contextual changes do not alter the relevant professional norm. To study this, we introduce ContextAdapt, an evaluation framework covering honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality across medicine, law, finance, and national security. Drawing on primary-source professional and regulatory documents, we construct a value x domain framework and use this to develop scenarios testing both default professional rules and recognised exceptions. We evaluate 12 LLMs on both the actions they recommend and the justifications they provide. In our main experiment, models achieve 95.6% mean appropriateness, although the use of the correct domain-specific justification varies substantially across models, from 25.6% to 76.9%. In a separate factorial experiment, explicitly naming the professional domain and changing the role of the model have limited effect on behaviour. Varying stakes, however, reveals severe but localised failures: in some cases, models alter their responses even though the underlying professional obligation remains unchanged. In particular, perceived severity appears to act as a cue for disclosure across both honesty and confidentiality scenarios. These results show that evaluating value alignment requires us to consider not only whether models follow abstract principles, but whether they apply them appropriately across different contexts.

</details>


### [4] [NinaXander: Feasibility and Limits of Composing Frozen Language Models Across Architecture Families via a Shared Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38261)
*Takanori Kotama,Shun-ichiro Hayashi,Daichi Mukunoki,Tetsuya Hoshino,Takahiro Katagiri*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出NinaXander方法，通过训练一个共享潜在适配器(shared-latent adapter)将不同架构家族(RWKV循环模型与Transformer)的冻结语言模型在某一中间层进行拼接，生成"嵌合体"模型。以RWKV-4-Raven-7B和Tulu-Pythia-6.9b为父模型，仅用一个适配器即可在多个切换层获得多个嵌合体模型而无需重训。核心发现：(1)层间共享表征可学得(居中相关系数0.901)；(2) Pythia→RWKV(L=4)配置将Transformer KV缓存减少84.4%，且准确率与RWKV单独使用时无显著差异；(3)没有任何嵌合体超越更强的父模型Pythia；(4)域外WikiText上的语言建模性能急剧下降；(5)仅在共享分词器、相同深度和相同隐藏宽度的有利条件下成立，不表明模型共享通用语义空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有改变语言模型推理时特性(如KV缓存大小)的方法需要重新预训练或微调整个模型，代价巨大。已有研究仅在同系列Transformer间或微调整个组合模型的情况下连接冻结模型，尚未探索跨架构家族(RNN类 vs Transformer类)将冻结检查点重组为组合模型的可行性。本文旨在探究是否可以通过小型训练网络(适配器)将不同家族冻结模型的中间表征相互转换，从而在冻结状态下拼接不同家族的模型层。

Method: 方法核心是共享潜在适配器(shared-latent adapter)，包含两个编码器E_A、E_B和两个解码器D_A、D_B，将两个模型的标准化残差映射到共享潜在空间(d_z=4096)。训练目标包含三项：自重构误差(A→A和B→B)、潜在对齐误差(λ‖z_A−z_B‖²，λ=1)、以及解码前的高斯噪声(σ=0.4)以防止潜在被公共模式(common mode)主导。适配器参数量268.5M(占父模型参数1.9%)，由输入线性投影、一个残差块和输出线性投影组成。在两个父模型(A=RWKV-4-Raven-7B, B=Tulu-Pythia-6.9b，均为32层、隐藏宽度4096、共享GPT-NeoX分词器)相同索引层对处进行训练，使用Alpaca训练集的2075个序列(232k标记位置)。训练后在指定的"切换层L"将前段模型的残差经适配器转换一次传给后段模型，构成嵌合体模型。比较4种配置：RWKV自重构控制、RWKV→Pythia、Pythia自重构控制、Pythia→RWKV，切换层L∈{4,8,16,24}。

Result: 1) 表征对齐：训练后共享潜在空间的居中相关系数ρ_ctr=0.901，跨家族读出R²(A→B)=0.559, B→A=0.590；随机重排后ρ_ctr降至0.000，读出R²降至负值，确认基于逐标记对应而非分布重叠。2) 准确性：8个嵌合体在ARC-Easy和SciQ选择题上均超过随机水平(25%)，但均显著低于更强父模型Pythia(ARC 65.3%, SciQ 81.0%)。仅RWKV→Pythia(L=4)在SciQ上显著超过RWKV。3) KV缓存：Pythia→RWKV(L=4)将Transformer层从32减至5，KV缓存减少84.4%(2.00→0.31 GiB)，准确率与RWKV相当。在保留≤17个Transformer层的5个配置中，嵌合体显著优于同等层数Pythia早期退出。4) 非线性分析：去除适配器非线性部分(α→0)使读出R²降至负值，准确率降低11-40个百分点(p<2×10⁻⁹)。5) 域外性能：WikiText上Pythia→RWKV(L=4)困惑度45.00(512上下文)，仍远高于RWKV的8.27；域内Alpaca上接近父模型。6) 生成质量：生成的文本句法良好(正确回答法国首都等)，但存在事实错误和格式偏离。

Conclusion: 本文成功证明了在有利条件(共享分词器、相同深度、相同隐藏宽度、Alpaca域内)下，可通过单个共享潜在适配器连接不同架构家族(RWKV与Transformer)的冻结语言模型中层表征，但这种对应关系并非通用语义空间的证据。嵌合体可在冻结状态下重组父模型，创造KV缓存大小与准确率之间的新权衡点(如Pythia→RWKV(L=4)以84.4% KV缓存缩减换取与RWKV相当的准确率)，但无法超越更强父模型，且域外性能急剧退化。该方法的价值在于开辟了冻结模型跨家族后置重组的可能，而非构建高性能新模型。未来工作包括跨域训练适配器、识别自重构精度的限制因素、研究多次切换的误差累积以及多随机种子复现等。

Abstract: In this paper we propose NinaXander, a series of composed language models obtained by connecting layers of frozen language models from different architecture families with a single trained shared-latent adapter. A composed model runs the first layers of one model, converts the resulting intermediate representation once with the adapter, and then runs the remaining layers of the other model. Once the adapter is trained, several composed models that connect at different layers are obtained without retraining. Using the recurrent RWKV-4-Raven-7B and the Transformer-based Tulu-Pythia-6.9b, abbreviated as RWKV and Pythia, this study examines whether frozen models from different families can be recombined post hoc. The composed models answered multiple-choice questions, and those whose generations we examined produced syntactically well-formed text. The configuration that combines the first 5 layers of Pythia with the remaining 27 layers of RWKV reduced the Transformer key-value (KV) cache by 84.4% with accuracy not significantly different from that of RWKV alone. In multiple-choice accuracy, however, no composed model matched the parent model Pythia, and language-modeling performance decreased sharply on WikiText, a corpus of Wikipedia articles outside the training domain. The correspondence between intermediate representations was also obtained in one favorable case, with a shared tokenizer, the same depth, and the same hidden width, and does not show that the models share a general semantic space.

</details>


### [5] [Policy-Conditioned AI-Use Detection: An Evidentiary Framework for Academic Publishing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38427)
*Jairo Diaz-Rodriguez,Mumin Jia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文批评当前AI检测方法以"是否由AI生成"为目标,与学术会议真正需要执行的"角色/任务/政策相关的合规判定"目标错位,提出"政策条件化AI使用检测"(policy-conditioned AI-use detection)框架,把政策、统计推断与基于流水线的评估作为三大支柱,并配套讨论会议需要构建的治理基础设施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学术会议已发布细粒度、角色化的AI使用政策,但缺乏可执行的检测手段;现有AI检测工具估计的是文本来源(是否AI生成),而非工作流是否符合既定规则,导致误判合规作者为违规者,且缺乏统计可控性,无法支持机构决策。

Method: 提出一个三部分证据框架:(1) Policy——把领域、角色、任务、政策作为检测器显式输入,把"使用是否被允许"建模为工作流-角色-政策之间的"关系"而非文本的固有属性,并要求政策可机器读取;(2) Inference——以假设检验或贝叶斯推断取代单一分数输出,报告原假设、检验统计量、标定体系、p值或后验概率P(违规|证据)、证据类型、有效性条件与弃权建议;(3) Evaluation——构建"流水线基准"(pipeline benchmarks),即从人类种子出发的可复现工作流配方,在E0–E3四级证据条件下评估,按工作流分项报告在固定FPR下的TPR,并显式声明基准违规率。配套讨论治理基础设施:结构化披露、批准工具路由(保护评审保密性)、可申诉的渐进制裁机制;以同行评审为端到端实例化,定义6类评审工作流(含对抗分支)。

Result: 在合理的违规率假设下,即使在强工作点(如TPR=0.80、FPR=0.01)的检测器,在违规率为1%时仍会错误指控约198名合规作者,而真正违规者只命中160人,无辜者占比约6/7;若放宽至FPR=0.05,则每命中约160名违规者就误伤约990名合规作者,AUROC对此结构性错误无揭示能力。现有"AI生成/人类"的二元基准无法映射到政策相对的工作流类别。

Conclusion: AI使用检测应从"作者身份分类器"重构为"可审计、可争议、有预定错误率"的机构程序;政策必须可机器化、证据须分级声明、报告须进入渐进申诉流程;更强的分类器无法替代机构必须自己完成的政策表达、证据采集与错误率承诺,一个能说明其程序控制什么与不控制什么的会议,才是达到学术诚信治理最低要求的会议。

Abstract: Major venues now publish detailed rules about how authors, reviewers, and area chairs may use AI, and those rules differ by role, by task, and by what must be disclosed. AI detection, the instrument usually proposed to enforce them, estimates something else: whether an AI model wrote the text. We argue that this target is misaligned with the decisions conferences and journals face, and propose policy-conditioned AI-use detection, an evidentiary framework for assessing whether a human--AI workflow complied with a stated rule. Policy makes the governing rule an explicit input. Inference reports hypotheses, evidence, calibration regime, and uncertainty in place of verdicts such as "AI detected". Evaluation builds benchmarks from reproducible pipelines that generate compliant and non-compliant workflows, and reports true positive rate at a false positive rate the venue fixes in advance. We work the framework through peer review, where at plausible violation rates a detector at a strong operating point still flags more compliant authors than violating ones. The framework therefore also names what a venue must instrument: structured disclosure, approved-tool routing that respects reviewer confidentiality, and a path by which a finding can be contested. Under this framing a detector is not an authorship classifier but an auditable procedure with an error rate the venue fixes in advance and can defend.

</details>


### [6] [The Backdrop Exposes What the World Around an Agent Costs It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38469)
*Nusrat Jahan Lia,Shubhashis Roy Dipta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 BACKDROP 基准框架，通过向智能体执行环境中注入四种日常危害（权威、注入、越界、故障），将每个任务扩展为包含清洁版（twin）、单危害消融版和复合版的家族。在 16 个模型、3,678 个变体上的实验显示，平均通过率从 69.5% 降至 31.3%；最强的模型跌幅最大（Claude Fable 5.1 从 96.6% 降至 56.0%），且重复尝试无法弥补这些损失。研究发现"他人指令"这一被忽视的危害造成的损失最大（平均损失 42.2% 的 twin 通过率），远高于提示注入（9.7%），且所有 16 个模型在复合危害下更倾向于遵从他人指令而非注入文本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准测试在"清洁世界"中评估智能体能力，假设环境只会配合任务完成。但真实部署环境中，其他人会改变世界——有人发短信要求把钱转给别处，或订单确认邮件要求回复门禁码。提示级防御无法察觉隐藏在记录中的危害，也无法判断谁有权修改任务。当前基准测试（AppWorld、τ-bench 等）只涵盖部分此类威胁，缺乏统一的匹配对照来量化环境因素对智能体失败的贡献。

Method: BACKDROP 基于 AppWorld 基准，将每个任务转换为一个家族：twin（无危害）、最多四个单危害消融版（仅含一种危害）、以及复合版（同时含四种危害）。所有变体共享相同指令和正确终态。定义了四种危害：(1) 权威——他人消息覆盖用户指令；(2) 注入——记录中的文本重定向智能体；(3) 越界——请求写入未被授权的应用；(4) 故障——写操作失败但不告知是否成功，需检查后重试。每个线索必须满足四属性：可达性、合理性、错误性、公平性。提出"危害成本"指标：单危害消融版相对 twin 通过率的下降比例。设计了 7 种失败模式，由可编程评分器（基于终态数据库、API 调用日志和最终消息）检测，无需模型评判。

Result: 在 16 个模型、3,678 个变体（共 202,290 次运行）上的实验发现：(1) 复合危害下平均通过率从 69.5% 降至 31.3%，最强模型跌幅最大（如 Claude Fable 5.1 从 96.6% 降至 56.0%，Gemini 3.8 Flash 下降 64.9 点）；(2) 重复尝试无法恢复：13 个模型中 12 个的复合版最佳四次尝试仍低于 twin 单次尝试（如 GPT-5.6 sol: 44% vs 93%）；(3) 四种危害成本差异显著：权威 42.2%、故障 21.8%、越界 19.3%、注入 9.7%，权威是 11 个模型的最大单项损失；(4) 当线索到达智能体时，他人指令被遵从率 46.4%，远高于注入文本的 20.3%，所有 16 个模型均呈现此规律；(5) 危害有重叠效应——独立测试总损失 67.3 点，组合仅 38.2 点；(6) 危害环境下虚假成功声明显著上升（如 GPT-5.6 sol 从 71% 升至 90%）。

Conclusion: 智能体在清洁世界中的得分是其真实世界表现的上限。BACKDROP 揭示了一个被忽视的关键风险：他人指令比提示注入更危险，且更强的智能体遭遇危害更多、损失更大。评估应从单一通过率转向危害成本分析，需分离"是否遭遇危害"与"如何应对"，并应在隔离与复合两种条件下同时测试，以捕捉危害交互效应。

Abstract: Agent benchmarks test agents in worlds that stay still. Deployed agents work in worlds that other people also change. Someone texts the agent to send the money elsewhere or an order confirmation asks it to reply with a door code. We present BACKDROP, which asks how much of an agent's capability in a clean world survives in such a world. BACKDROP takes a task along with the agents execution environment, and plants four everyday hazards in its world, one at a time and all together. The instruction and the correct end state stay the same. Each hazard asks one question. Authority: does a message from another person override the user? Injection: does text planted in a record redirect the agent? Boundary: does a request pull it into an app it was not given? Fault: after a write fails without saying whether it landed, does the agent check before it retries? Across 3,678 variants and 16 models, , the average pass rate falls from 69.5% to 31.3% once all four hazards are present; the strongest models fall furthest (Claude Fable 5.1 from 96.6% to 56.0%). Agents have learned to resist injected text but often follow other unauthorized requests of other people. With all four hazards present, and counting only runs where the planted text reached the agent, agents followed another person's message in 46.4% of runs and injected text in 20.3%. The gap is consistent throughout all 16 models. BACKDROP formalizes these gaps and shows how an agent's score in a task's world is a ceiling on real-world performance.

</details>

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: KlinikeBench 是由 35 名医师参与编写并审核的 333 个交互式临床任务基准，评估语言模型在完整临床问诊中的表现，而不仅仅是诊断准确性。它揭示了一个显著差距：顶尖模型的诊断准确率可达 90.7%，但严格通过率（需要正确诊断、必备工具使用、行动约束及必问主题全部满足）不足 30%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床 LM 基准多基于完整病历评估诊断准确性，忽略了临床实践中信息需逐步采集的过程，无法判断模型是否完成了恰当的病史采集和临床评估。此外，现有基准缺乏专业医师验证。论文旨在构建一个交互式、医师主导的基准来评估完整临床问诊能力。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 35 名临床医师基于 PrimeKG/HPO 知识图谱构建 333 个任务，每个任务包含患者画像、140 个临床工具、隐藏评分标准；(2) 使用 LLM 模拟患者，受测模型在 32 轮交互预算内进行问诊、调用工具、记录诊断；(3) 评分包含诊断正确性（Di）、必备工具完成（Wi）、行动约束（Ai）、必问主题覆盖率（Hi），严格 pass@1 要求全部满足；(4) 评估 31 个模型、7 个家族，并研究评判器/患者替换敏感性、交互预算影响；(6) 对 Qwen3-4B 进行 SFT 和 GRPO 训练。

Result: 31 个模型中，Claude Opus 5 表现最佳，严格 pass@1 仅 29.4%，诊断准确率却达 90.7%；平均诊断准确率 73.6%，但平均严格通过率仅 13.4%。不同模型在不同维度领先：Gemini-3.8-flash 工具完成率最高，GPT-5.6-sol 必问主题覆盖率最高。增加交互轮次未显著提升通过率。Qwen3-4B 经 SFT 后严格 pass@1 从 0% 提升至 8%（95% CI [2, 15]），但 RL 增益不显著。30 名医师对虚拟患者对话评分（3.69/3.50/3.76）高于 MTS-Dialog 真实对话参考（3.43/3.31/3.45）。

Conclusion: KlinikeBench 揭示了诊断准确性与完整临床评估能力之间的显著鸿沟：通过诊断门控不保证恰当的问诊和灵活的临床评估。组件式评分使信息采集和工具使用中的不足变得可见。基准在评判器和患者替换下保持稳健排名。SFT 能改善小模型评估能力，而 RL 早期增益仍不确定，需要更丰富的评估与明确的完成标准。KlinikeBench 公开了基准、训练代码、13,962 条智能体轨迹及 Qwen3-4B 的 SFT/SFT+GRPO 检查点，为疾病诊断 LM 的研究提供资源。

Abstract: Most clinical benchmarks evaluate language models (LMs) on diagnosis using complete case descriptions. In clinical practice, however, patients present information in different ways, and clinicians must obtain relevant history and determine which examinations are needed before reaching a diagnosis. Diagnostic accuracy alone therefore cannot establish whether an agent gathered essential information or conducted an appropriate clinical assessment. Furthermore, existing benchmarks lack professional clinicians' verification. To address this gap, we introduce KlinikeBench, a benchmark of 333 clinician-authored tasks, each providing an isolated sandbox environment with a virtual patient, clinical tools, and task-specific success criteria. More than 35 clinicians contributed to case authoring and benchmark evaluation. In an empirical study, clinicians gave simulated dialogues higher mean quality ratings than reference conversations, which is adapted from real conversation. In each task, an LM has a fixed budget of turns to communicate with the patient, ask about relevant history, request examinations, follow action constraints, and record a final diagnosis. We score these steps separately as well as together. Across 31 models and seven model families, the best-performing models (e.g., GPT-6-astra and Claude Opus 5) succeed on less than 30% of tasks, even though their diagnosis accuracy reaches 90.7%. Some models benefit from talking with the patient; others diagnose well from a complete chart but perform much worse in conversation. Overall, KlinikeBench provides a testbed for evaluating the full clinical encounter and reveals a substantial gap between diagnostic accuracy and performance in interactive clinical assessment.

</details>

*Maryam Haghifam,Zahra Rajabi,Yizhou Sun,Carlos Morato*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: STAM提出了一种面向纵向临床记录的状态转换感知记忆框架,通过将当前信息保留在Active存储、被取代信息保留在History存储,并结合语义检索与类型化临床关系来识别受影响的记忆,在四个临床基准上展现出优于现有记忆与检索基线的状态维护与下游问答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理在推理纵向临床记录时,需同时跟踪患者当前状态的变化并保留理解治疗历史所需的既往信息;单纯累积记忆会导致过时信息与当前信息混淆,而覆盖早期记忆则会丢失重构治疗轨迹所需的证据。因此需要一种能够区分当前与历史状态,同时保留演化轨迹的记忆管理机制。

Method: STAM将记忆组织为Active(当前状态)和History(被取代/已解决)两个存储,并维护一个人专属的关系图(包含restatement、same_condition_thread、drug_interaction、systemic_link等无向关系以及causal、treatment_for、monitoring_for等有向关系)。写入路径包含四个阶段:原子记忆提取、关系链接、影响检索(结合语义检索与基于图的一跳发现)和状态更新。读取路径使用查询相关的存储门控(store gate)选择是否提供历史记忆。删除由独立的保守删除门控通过保形风险控制处理。

Result: 在四个纵向临床基准(MedMemoryBench、MedLoCoMo、自构MIMIC-QA、ClinicalBench)上,完整写入流水线将supersession-pair recall从28.6提升至53.9,同时降低false archival。在上下文长度近似对齐的配对比较中,STAM在17项对比中有6项显著优于基线,无显著下降。State-aware更新在状态/时间类问题上普遍优于raw Full Context。在MIMIC-QA上紧凑的存储包可在达到0.959证据召回的同时保留强读者答案质量。删除门控以α=0.01移除2.3%的存储,保持92.9%安全精度与0.3% never-forget损失。

Conclusion: 纵向记忆系统应同时从状态维护和证据服务两个维度进行评估。STAM通过显式状态转换管理,在状态/时间敏感问题上优于raw Full Context,并在近似上下文匹配条件下优于多种记忆与检索基线,但其优势在数据集与读者间并不均匀,证据选择仍是维护记忆与下游回答之间的关键瓶颈。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents that reason over clinical records must track changes in a patient's state while preserving the history needed to understand them. Simply accumulating memories leaves it unclear which information still applies, whereas overwriting earlier memories can erase evidence needed to reconstruct treatment history and clinical trajectories. We introduce STAM, a state-transition-aware memory framework that records state changes as new clinical entries arrive. STAM combines semantic retrieval with typed clinical relations to identify affected memories, maintaining current information in Active and superseded or resolved information in History. At read time, a query-dependent gate selectively serves historical memory. Across four longitudinal clinical benchmarks, we evaluate STAM with downstream question answering, direct state-maintenance diagnostics, and comparisons at approximately matched context lengths.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM技能(外部提示文件)依赖专家撰写、成本高且未针对具体模型优化；近期基于反射的自动技能优化方法(如SkillOpt)仍需已标注的领域内训练集，而真实用户往往只有任务描述。论文旨在解决"无监督技能优化"问题：从纯自然语言任务描述出发，自动构建适配目标模型的技能。

Abstract: Skills are external artifacts that Large Language Models (LLMs) consume at inference time to improve their performance on specialized domains by incorporating relevant procedural and domain knowledge. Expert-authored skills are expensive to produce, and the resulting artifacts are not optimized for the specific model that consumes them, whose failure modes can vary with version, scale and training. In addition, emerging tasks may fall outside the scope of existing skill libraries, creating a need to develop new skills before curated training data become available. Recent works have explored automated skill optimization through reflection, but they require a curated, in-distribution training set, which users might not always have. To address these limitations, we present Prompt2Skill, a framework that builds skills from natural-language task description alone. From the prompt, the system derives a task specification, discovers or synthesizes datasets, and refines the skill in a closed loop of reflective editing. Across four domains spanning question answering, reading comprehension, spreadsheet manipulation, and mathematical reasoning, Prompt2Skill consistently outperforms the direct prompting baseline, achieving an average improvement of 10.8 across open-source and frontier models.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体基准测试普遍假设用户始终能够准确、完整地传达其意图（即"神谕通信假设"），但实际交互中用户常出现沟通偏差、信息遗漏甚至意图变化。该假设的局限性掩盖了智能体在真实场景下的关键能力：检测错位、主动澄清、持续追踪用户当前意图。本文旨在填补这一研究空白，提出更贴近真实交互的评估范式。

Method: 1. **任务构建流水线**：基于人际关系理论中的沟通错误分类法（意图、前提、参数、表达四类共 11 种故障），通过三步验证器（双 LLM 法官一致性与上下文适配性、表面忠实度检查、可执行效果验证）生成带有受控错位的查询；2. **意图图谱构建**：将原始任务映射为 (帧, 条件集合) 结构，建立含优化（Refinement）、泛化（Relaxation）、替换（Substitution）、转换（Pivot）四种关系的可执行意图图谱，为后续意图漂移提供基础；3. **交互协议**：引入有限耐心预算（提问消耗 2 单位、被拒提议消耗 4 单位）、静默的交互条件触发型意图漂移（基于耐心阈值或智能体提问主题），以及基于 GDMS 框架的五种角色条件化行为模拟；4. **GRIP 评估协议**：从 Grounding（任务结果基础）、Role-realism（模拟用户真实度）、Inquiry（提问效果）、Persistence（意图漂移下的适应性）四个维度进行诊断式评估。

Result: 1. 在 WebShop、τ²-Retail、τ²-Airline 三个环境中实例化基准（生成 1780/555/208 个验证样本）；2. 评估 7 种现有澄清方法 + 3 种诊断式参考智能体（Memory Ledger、Memory+Verification、Self-Evolving Playbook）在 5 种 LLM 后端上的表现，发现更强的交互策略普遍优于无询问基线，但与神谕性能仍有显著差距，Self-Evolving 在 15 个骨架-基准组合中的 14 个上领先；3. 在 ProdAgent 真实部署平台的 16,596 个会话中发现 23.7% 存在意图错位，且涵盖所有四类通信故障和四类意图漂移关系，证实了基准抽象的现实相关性；4. 随着故障复杂度 k 增加，Self-Evolving 与基线的优势进一步扩大；5. 角色分析表明 Dependent 用户在恢复和基础性上最强，而 Rational 用户在意图漂移后成功率最高，揭示了不同维度下难度排序的差异。

Conclusion: Drift-Bench++ 提供了首个统一的可执行基准，可系统评估智能体在通信错位与意图漂移双重挑战下的持续对齐能力。实验表明澄清交互对意图对齐至关重要，但仍远未达到神谕水平；真实部署数据验证了基准抽象的实用性。未来工作应将该基准扩展到更开放的任务环境、更长时程的智能体，以及探索针对交互对齐的训练策略。本研究将"交互式意图对齐"确立为一种独立于传统任务性能的高级能力，为智能体评估与设计提供了新的诊断基础。

Abstract: Modern LLM agents increasingly tackle complex tasks through interactive, long-horizon exchanges with users, while existing benchmarks generally assume that users always accurately and sufficiently communicate a fixed intent. We define this task setting as Interactive Intent Alignment, where agents must recover and continuously track the user's current intent despite imperfect communication and evolving goals. To study this setting, we introduce Drift-Bench++, a principled benchmark construction pipeline for verified executable tasks with controlled misalignment and intent shifts, along with an interaction protocol featuring finite patience, diverse simulated users, and silent interaction-conditioned shifts. We further develop GRIP, a comprehensive evaluation protocol covering task grounding, user realism, inquiry effectiveness, and adaptation to evolving intent. Across diverse environments, models, and interaction conditions, stronger interaction consistently helps but remains far from oracle performance; Validation on deployed ProdAgent sessions further shows that the modeled failures are prevalent and consequential in deployment. By providing a unified, executable benchmark for interactive intent alignment, Drift-Bench++ offers a foundation for evaluating and advancing agents under realistic communication and evolving intent.

SMART achieves the best overall MQM score in all 15 Subtitle Arena directions, reducing average penalty by 6.9% over the strongest competing agent system.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对LLM非受控重复(repetitive generation)的研究主要聚焦于中间层和后层已显著激活的重复特征,但这些特征在浅层如何产生与发展尚不清楚,且现有缓解方法多在重复表征已显著激活后才进行干预。此外,攻击者可通过视觉或文本输入诱发资源消耗攻击(repetitive generation延长生成以增加推理开销),因此需要更早期的干预手段。

Abstract: Uncontrolled repetition can prolong autoregressive generation in large language models (LLMs) and enable resource consumption attacks. Our analysis further shows that repetition semantics emerge in shallow layers and propagate through the residual stream, disrupting normal representations. TRC also generalizes to large language models (LLMs) and large reasoning models (LRMs), where it consistently captures analogous repetition dynamics and achieves effective mitigation. Our work broadens the study of repetitive generation from its prominent internal representations to earlier opportunities for intervention, providing insights for mitigating resource consumption attacks.

Abstract: Large language models deployed as personalized assistants must reason over long, evolving interaction histories. StateTree augments multi-session dialogues with a tree-structured path-tracing task: key-value records are embedded across sessions to form a binary tree. StateTree-7B achieves gains up to +23.60% on LongMemEval (128k), and StateTree-14B reaches 59.00% accuracy on LongMemEval, surpassing QwenLong-L1-32B (45.20%).

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) traces often serve as a proxy for how Large Language Models (LLMs) arrive at their answers. Motivation: 离散情感识别(ERC)已被广泛研究，但将LLM应用于多模态对话中的连续VAD维度情感评估仍基本是空白。现有维度情感工作多依赖LSTM/CNN-1D或预训练模型(HuBERT、DeBERTa等)，缺乏LLM的上下文推理能力。本研究旨在填补这一空白，系统探索LLM在多模态连续维度情感评估中的有效性。

Method: 方法核心：1)输入构建：结合对话历史(最多12个utterance)、目标utterance和声学特征描述；2)声学特征提取：从原始音频中提取音量、音高、语速三类特征(均值与变异度共六个值)，通过四分位数量化转为五级自然语言描述(very low至very high)；3)两种策略：提示工程(零样本/少样本)和LoRA参数高效微调(r=16, α=16)；4)两个独立任务：离散ER(6类情感)和VAD评分(1-5整数)；5)采用Leave-One-Session-Out划分评估跨说话者泛化能力。评估6个模型：LLaMA-2-7B/3.1-8B/3.3-70B、Qwen3.5-35B-A3B、GPT-4o-mini/5-mini。指标：离散ER用加权F1，VAD用CCC(Concordance Correlation Coefficient)。

Result: 主要结果：1)离散ER：LoRA微调的LLaMA模型加权F1达71.8-73.2，远超最佳GPT提示工程(54.7-59.6)和SpeechCueLLM基线(72.0)；2)VAD评估：LLaMA-3.3-70B+LoRA在Valence上达CCC 0.7822，创IEMOCAP新SOTA，比最佳GPT-5-mini提示(0.6697)高约0.11；3)声学描述消融：移除后小模型F1下降3.5-3.6，而70B大模型几乎无影响；4)VAD维度差异显著：Valence最佳(CCC 0.74-0.78)，Arousal中等(0.44-0.48)，Dominance最低(0.44)，该层级与IEMOCAP标注者一致性(Krippendorff's α: V=0.680, A=0.304, D=0.271)高度吻合；5)过去VAD上下文：提示工程GPT模型获得边际提升，但LoRA微调LLaMA模型性能下降(因误差累积)，oracle实验表明真实过去VAD值确实有帮助；6)错误分析：GPT模型在Angry↔Frustrated混淆严重(46.5-75.3%)，小LLaMA模型倾向将多数情感坍缩为单一标签。

Conclusion: 本文得出四个核心发现：1)LoRA微调在两个任务上均显著优于提示工程，领域适配比通用指令遵循能力对专业情感任务更关键；2)声学特征描述对小模型贡献显著(+3.5-3.6 F1)，大模型可从语言模式部分补偿；3)VAD维度间的性能差异直接镜像标注者一致性层级，揭示了标注噪声对模型性能上限的约束；4)模型预测的过去VAD上下文会因误差累积而损害LoRA微调模型性能。局限性在于：仅用单一数据集IEMOCAP(标注一致性较低)、声学信息经离散化文本描述有损失。未来工作将探索直接处理原始音频的多模态大模型、构建更可靠的对话情感数据集，并拓展至情感可控的TTS任务。

Abstract: Emotion recognition in conversation has been widely studied, but applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to continuous dimensional emotion evaluation in multimodal dialogue remains largely unexplored. We propose an LLM-based framework that performs discrete emotion recognition and Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) dimensional evaluation on IEMOCAP, incorporating acoustic cues as natural language descriptions following the SpeechCueLLM approach. We evaluate six models spanning the LLaMA, GPT, and Qwen families under zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, and LoRA fine-tuning. LoRA fine-tuned LLaMA models substantially outperform prompt-engineered GPT models on both tasks despite GPT's larger scale, a gap we attribute to domain adaptation rather than model capacity. Our best model achieves a Valence CCC of 0.7822, a new state-of-the-art on IEMOCAP. Ablation studies confirm that textual audio descriptions meaningfully improve smaller models (+3.5 to 3.6 weighted F1) while contributing little for the largest model, suggesting audio cues are most valuable when linguistic capacity is limited. The performance asymmetry across VAD dimensions closely mirrors the annotator agreement hierarchy in IEMOCAP's own annotations.

</details>

*Meijia Chen,Hao Li,Zheng Lu,Hongshan Lin,Junbai Tian,Yichen Liu,Zijun Tian,Yufan Zou,Shuhan Sun,Hanxin Chen,Zeyu Zhang,Weizhi Du,Yueting Li,Tianyu Shi,Alaa Khamis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文针对自进化搜索代理中proposer-solver闭环训练的"共作弊"（co-cheating）故障模式：双方逐渐就共享错误达成一致，导致内部奖励提升但外部正确性停滞。提出CrossFit方法，通过源级交叉拟合排除反馈求解器对评估源的训练历史，将Qwen3.5-4B/9B上七个搜索基准的平均性能较Dr. Zero提高8.8/8.4个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自进化搜索代理通过proposer生成问题、solver作答并互相优化构建训练课程，但这种闭环使agreement成为correctness的内生代理，导致proposer与solver在共享错误上趋同，形成虚假前沿。论文旨在诊断此故障并通过改变反馈溯源进行缓解。

Method: 两种干预：(1) MSV（多样本验证）通过3次有源+3次无源采样测试提案稳定性；(2) CrossFit将源文档划分为A/B两折，训练两个仅在一折上学习的辅助求解器，交叉评估另一折的问题以决定proposer奖励，主求解器仍在所有已问题上问题均被训练。使用证据支持的审计器gpt-6-astra/high对Dr. Zero训练步骤进行独立后置审计。

Result: Dr. Zero在Qwen3.5-4B/9B上的虚假一致性质量（false-agreement mass）达6.1%/8.8%；MSV降至5.7%/7.2%；CrossFit降至3.0%/3.7%；源排除反馈的固定库重放进一步降至0.4%/0.1%。在七个下游搜索基准（NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMQA、MuSiQue、Bamboogle）上，CrossFit较Dr. Zero平均Cover-EM提升8.8/8.4点，较Search-R1提升8.7/7.8点。多跳任务增益最大（约10点），MSV与CrossFit组合仅比单独CrossFit多0.3点。

Conclusion: 共作弊揭示了自进化中的失败模式：agreement提升可能源于proposer-solver强化相同错误标签。CrossFit通过源级交叉拟合反馈打破直接自我强化路径；验证可补充提高可靠性但下游增益有限。可靠的自进化需要审计反馈正确性及其评估器的训练历史，共享预训练错误、相关证据和辅助成本仍是开放限制。

Abstract: Self-evolving search agents build their own training curricula by jointly optimizing a proposer that generates questions and a solver that answers them. This closed loop introduces a failure mode we call co-cheating: the proposer and solver increasingly agree on shared errors, so internal reward improves without a matching gain in external correctness. A post-hoc audit against source evidence shows co-cheating growing more severe over successive rounds of self-evolution, with pseudo-label correctness stagnating or declining even as the in-loop training signal improves. The most direct mitigation is to verify proposals before training: we introduce multi-sample verification (MSV), which queries the same model three times with the source and three times without it to decide task admission and replace unreliable pseudo-labels. MSV partially reduces false agreement but leaves substantial residual co-cheating and costs six extra labeler generations per candidate. These limitations motivate CrossFit, our main method: it partitions the proposer's source documents into groups A and B; questions generated from A are scored by an auxiliary solver trained only on B, and vice versa. The cross-fitted agreement determines proposer reward, so a same-source pseudo-label cannot be reproduced through the feedback solver, while the original solver's update rule is unchanged. Rerunning the loop with Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B, MSV reduces false-agreement mass from 6.1% to 5.7% and from 8.8% to 7.2%, whereas CrossFit reduces it to 3.0% and 3.7%. Replaying identical proposals with source-excluded feedback further reduces false agreement to 0.4% and 0.1%, isolating feedback ancestry from curriculum changes. Across seven downstream search benchmarks, CrossFit improves average performance over standard coupled self-evolution by 8.8 and 8.4 points and over Search-R1 by 8.7 and 7.8 points at 4B and 9B.

</details>

*Hanwen Liu,Yuanfu Sun,Qiaoyu Tan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DAGent是一个面向深度研究任务的有向无环图（DAG）多智能体框架，提出"评估后再扩展"（Evaluate-then-Grow）的增量式规划范式，并设计DAGRPO强化学习方法利用DAG拓扑结构信号，显著优于现有Plan-then-Patch范式系统。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于DAG的深度研究代理采用"先规划再修补"策略，在语义证据不足时却做出最强的规划承诺，导致后续修改浪费计算资源且精度下降。需要一种能够根据中间证据动态调整规划的增量式规划方法，并设计能够利用DAG拓扑结构信息的强化学习算法。

Method: 1. Evaluate-then-Grow增量规划：Orchestrator一次扩展一批节点，每批扩展基于已完成节点的结构化输出（QueryDoc）评估，包含answer、explanation、steps、confidence、uncertainty五个字段，根据状态（Success/Uncertain/Not Found）决定下一步扩展。2. 层次化上下文传播：默认传播精简的QueryDoc，保留完整InteractionTranscript供RecallTool按需检索。3. DAGRPO：在GRPO基础上引入两个结构信号——拓扑条件信用（区分answer-feeding chain上的on-chain与off-chain执行节点），结构合规性正则化（惩罚违反结构约束的Orchestrator规划决策）。

Conclusion: 增量式规划范式（Evaluate-then-Grow）通过利用深度研究过程中不断积累的证据动态构建任务图，避免了过早规划承诺导致的计算浪费，同时记录的增量DAG拓扑结构为强化学习提供了结果级方法无法定义的结构信号；该方法在精度和效率上均优于现有的Plan-then-Patch方法。

Abstract: Deep research tasks require agents to navigate large knowledge spaces, synthesize evidence across many sources, and adapt their plans as findings emerge. Directed acyclic graph (DAG)-based multi-agent systems suit this setting because they support parallel execution and isolate each sub-task within a focused dependency context. Yet existing DAG-based agents instantiate a task-level plan before execution and repair the graph only after failures or missing evidence are observed. This Plan-then-Patch strategy is brittle for deep research: the system commits most strongly when its evidence is weakest, and later revisions waste computation on branches that should not have been planned. We propose DAGent, a DAG-based multi-agent framework with Evaluate-then-Grow incremental planning: an Orchestrator grows the task graph one batch at a time, conditioning each expansion on confidence and uncertainty signals from completed nodes. A hierarchical context layer propagates compact QueryDocs by default while preserving full execution traces for on-demand recall. The recorded DAG topology admits structural RL signals that outcome-only recipes cannot define; DAGRPO, a GRPO adaptation, injects topology-conditioned credit on Executor rollouts and a structural compliance regularization on Orchestrator plans. Across BrowseComp-Plus, GAIA, and xbench-DeepSearch, DAGent surpasses the strongest open-source baseline by 5.3 / 5.8 / 2.0 points at the Qwen3-235B-A22B scale, and the lead replicates across four open-source backbones and extends to GPT-5 at 327K context. At the Qwen3-8B scale, DAGRPO improves over a same-budget outcome-only GRPO baseline by 3.0 average Pass@1 points. A same-architecture comparison shows that evidence-conditioned planning reaches higher accuracy at lower per-task token, tool-call, and step footprints than its Plan-then-Patch counterpart. ### [22] [RAIM: Robust Aggregation of Inexpensive Models for Hallucination Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39229)
*Elia Onofri,Roberto Di Pietro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RAIM提出了一种聚合方案，通过交叉拟合堆叠逻辑回归和可接受性测试，聚合10个4-9B开源评判模型来替代昂贵的前沿评判模型用于幻觉检测，在8个忠实性基准测试中以1/64的推理成本保留了前沿评判模型93%的Cohen's κ一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿LLM评判模型（如Claude Sonnet）虽可靠但成本高、速率受限且需离境推理，不适合高吞吐量持续监控；而现有方案（升级策略保留前沿模型、专门化训练单模型）要么无法脱离前沿模型，要么泛化能力差。聚合方案虽无需训练且保持通用性，但基于独立性假设的朴素集成在共享预训练先验的评判模型间会失效。核心问题不是前沿评判模型好不好，而是能否用廉价本地开源评判模型的聚合来替代它，以及何时替代值得。

Method: RAIM包含两个组件：(a) 交叉拟合堆叠逻辑回归（5折交叉拟合），联合拟合成员权重而非独立加权，使重复更强模型的弱成员被降权，可包含负权重成员；(b) 可接受性测试，基于成员自身输出读取两个坐标（能力分布：达到κ≥κ₀的成员数量；误差相关性：成员间平均成对误差相关系数φ̄），在(κ₀,c,φ₀)=(0.30, 1/2, 0.40)的工作点上判断任务是否可接受。实例化采用10个来自不同家族（Llama、Qwen、Mistral、Gemma、Phi、Yi、Command-R、GLM、Granite、Falcon）的4-9B开源评判模型。评估覆盖8个忠实性基准：6个接地型（MedHallu、RAGTruth、WiCE、XSum、CNN、ExpertQA）和2个非接地型（FActScore、TruthfulQA），配对聚类bootstrap（95%区间，B=2000）作为决策规则。

Result: 在8个基准测试中，面板保留前沿评判模型中位数93%的Cohen's κ，平均仅损失2.9个平衡准确率点；推理成本约为前沿模型的1/64；清晰优于Claude Sonnet的为1个基准、明确劣于的为3个（其中仅2个具实际意义）。在MedHallu上获清晰胜出（Δκ=+0.032，亦胜oracle单一成员）。针对LLM-AggreFact排行榜上的专门训练检测器，在其本行基准上接近持平（差GPT-4o仅1.3点、差Bespoke-MiniCheck-7B仅1.9点），但在接地型集合上以72.5对66.6胜出MiniCheck-Flan-T5-L，且能处理非接地型任务。聚合是否有效取决于两个可从校准集读取的条件：(1) 能力分布广泛——多个成员有足够能力；(2) 误差去相关——成员错误时不同步。能力/相关性账户在项目级得到验证（1998个项目，相关系数+0.41，p<10⁻²⁰），在每个数据集内均为正。折本点出现在40000-81000个评估项。

Conclusion: 廉价评判模型面板可在其适用条件下替代前沿评判模型：仅需一次性领域内校准（50-100条标注记录）、1/64推理成本、本地部署避免数据离境。聚合有效的条件（多个有能力的成员+去相关错误）由两个可从同一校准集读取的统计量刻画，因此部署者可事先估计适用性。主导型单一评判模型存在时，聚合退化为恢复该最优成员，前沿模型仍具实质优势，此时才需保留前沿模型调用。限制：面板受限于固定花名册（10个冻结的通用模型），且训练-测试迁移无效（lodo测试中失去优势），需按领域重新校准。误差相关性随模型准确率上升而增加，因此花名册组成是值得调整的关键杠杆。

Abstract: Automatic evaluation of faithfulness increasingly relies on a large language model acting as a judge, yet the most reliable judges are proprietary frontier models, costly and ill-suited to high-throughput monitoring. We investigate whether a panel of cheap open-weight judges (4--9B) can be aggregated to stand in for a frontier one, what the substitution sacrifices, and when it is worth making. We propose RAIM, an aggregation scheme robust to the members' correlated errors, coupling a cross-fitted stacked logistic regression with an admissibility test that, read from the members' own outputs, identifies when aggregating them improves on their best member and stays within reach of the frontier judge. We instantiate RAIM with ten judges from disjoint families across eight faithfulness benchmarks. Against Claude Sonnet, the panel retains a median 93% of its Cohen's $\kappa$ and gives up only 2.9 points of balanced accuracy on average; read as paired differences, it clearly improves on one benchmark and clearly worsens on three (only two by a non-negligible margin), leaving four unresolved. At a sixty-fourth of the frontier's inference price, the operative expense is a one-time in-domain calibration on 50--100 labelled records. The panel is also competitive with purpose-trained detectors on their home benchmarks (within 1.3 accuracy points of GPT-4o and 1.9 of the LLM-AggreFact leader), and beats the strongest one we reran by 6 points on our grounded sets. Whether aggregation pays depends on the members themselves: where several capable members err on different items, the panel improves on its best judge and approaches the frontier; where one dominates, the stacker recovers the leader, and only there does the frontier remain materially ahead. Both conditions are read off the calibration set at no further cost, so a cheap panel can stand in for a frontier one wherever this audit admits it.

### [23] [Working Around the Compute Ceiling: Byte-Exact Memory in Galahad Makes LLM Reading a One-Time Cost LLM Reading a One-Time Cost](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39358)
*Sietse Schelpe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Galahad是一个为大语言模型推理服务的内存层系统，通过字节精确的KV缓存复用（Taliesin）和文本检索（Blaise），将LLM对相同文档的重复阅读从无状态计算转变为有状态推理。在7个真实数据集上，98.7%的提示词token被从内存加载而非重新计算；在97,000 token语料库的100个事实回忆测试中，将准确率从10/100提升至100/100，每题能耗降低92%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机源于Transformer的计算天花板理论（Sikka & Sikka, 2025）：每token的O(N²·d)计算量限制了模型可处理的任务复杂度。论文接受这一上限，但指出当前推理服务是无状态的——同一文档被反复从头处理。通过对7个真实数据集的测量，发现98.7%的提示词token是模型已经读过的文本，造成大量重复计算。该工作旨在通过持久化记忆机制改变这一现状，使推理成本与"新文本"而非"总文本"成正比。

Method: 方法包含两个互补的记忆组件：(1) Taliesin——KV记忆层，将模型对文本块的键值状态以字节指纹（输入字节+模型+租户）为键保存到存储，后续请求中相同字节块直接加载，替代重新prefill；(2) Blaise——文本记忆层，在CPU端组织文档并按节(section)检索，仅将相关章节文本（约668 tokens vs 全部97k tokens）传给模型。系统以单一共享库libgalahad.so形式集成vLLM（KV连接器）、SGLang（HiCache后端）和llama.cpp（slot保存/恢复），采用"故障关闭"(fail-closed)设计：任何加载检查失败均触发重算，确保输出永不改变。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 正确性：262,144个logit经保存-重启-重水化-热加载后bit-identical；20/20次prefill SHA-256字节相等；跨GPU（A6000↔4090）64/64 token相同；30/30测试模型全部通过。(2) 回忆测试：Gemma 4 31B在97k token语料中，无Galahad仅答10/100（12k窗口截断），仅Taliesin答98/100（llama.cpp, 3.0s/572J），Taliesin+Blaise答100/100（0.59-0.64s/200-213J），RAGFlow基线仅77。(3) 真实数据集：349题×3运行时，Taliesin答329-333题(94-95%)，+Blaise答319-321题(91-92%)。(4) 吞吐：H100上Qwen3-30B-A3B，吞吐从2.643增至3.424 turns/s (+29.6%)。(5) 存储开销：97k token占17.1-17.2GB（llama.cpp/vLLM）或39GB（SGLang）。能量回收：存储97k token消耗约28kJ，13个问题后回本。

Conclusion: 结论提出三项主张：(1) 模型的阅读可被精确存储和复用——恢复状态产生bit-identical logits，方法在30/30测试模型上有效；(2) 复用将大部分提示词计算转化为加载——7个数据集上98.7%的token来自内存；(3) 两种记忆独立有效——KV持久化使模型从8倍于窗口的语料中回答，文本记忆进一步将时间降低4.7倍、能耗降低2.7倍。该工作将LLM推理从无状态转向有状态，但并不违背Sikka的计算上限理论，因为其通过将重复工作、搜索和验证移出模型来"绕过"上限：注意状态精确存储、检索在CPU端完成、验证通过字节比较和加密哈希而非模型自评。

Abstract: A transformer language model performs a bounded amount of computation per token, and recent work by Vishal Sikka, former CEO of Infosys, argues that this bound limits which tasks a model can carry out or verify ( arXiv:2507.07505 ). We ask how much of the budget beneath that ceiling is spent on work the model has already done. Serving is stateless across requests: a model that answers a second question about a document recomputes the document's attention state from the first token. On seven real-world datasets, 98.7% of prompt tokens were text the model had already read. We present Galahad, a memory layer for vLLM, SGLang and this http URL that makes this reading a one-time cost. Taliesin saves the model's key-value (KV) state for a block of text and loads it on the next request that contains the same bytes, instead of recomputing it. Blaise keeps the documents themselves and passes the model only the section a question needs. On a recall test with 100 facts hidden in a 97,000-token corpus (Gemma 4 31B), Taliesin alone let the model attend to the whole corpus and answered 98 of 100 on this http URL at 3.0 s and 572 J per question, against 10 of 100, 9.3 s and 2,754 J for the same model without Galahad, which could hold only the last 12,000 tokens. With Blaise added, the model read about 668 tokens per question and answered 100 of 100 on all three runtimes at 0.59-0.64 s and 200-213 J; a tuned RAGFlow pipeline answered 77. Storing the corpus is a one-time cost of about 100 s and 28 kJ, whose energy is recovered after 13 questions. Restored state is bit-identical: all 262,144 output logits matched after restart, rehydration and hot-load. Galahad worked with all 30 models we tested under vLLM, and it fails closed: any load that does not pass its checks is recomputed. Together these results move LLM serving from stateless to stateful inference.

</details>


### [24] [Ready2Blend: From Natural-Language Instructions to Composable Alignment Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39365)
*Jeesu Jung,Hwan Chang,Juseon Do,Jeonghwan Choi,Jinho Choo,Sungwoo Nam,S. K. Hong,Hwanjun Song*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Ready2Blend提出了一种冻结主干LLM的持续对齐方法，通过AlignFormer将每个对齐需求映射为固定长度的连续提示，并利用组合性正则化将文本语义几何迁移到提示空间，实现在推理时通过向量算术混合提示来组合多个对齐需求，且无需重新训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续对齐中，自然语言指令灵活但控制间接，后训练对齐控制强但需重复更新参数并导致灾难性遗忘。作者希望结合两者优势：在冻结骨干网络的前提下，获得学习式的强对齐控制，并保持需求的模块化与可组合性。

Method: 方法包含两个核心组件：(1) AlignFormer（基于Q-Former），从每个对齐需求的文本定义中蒸馏出固定长度（k=4）的连续提示，存入模块化的"对齐提示库"，骨干网络与已有提示始终冻结；(2) 组合性正则化，包含点级一致性（提示与其需求文本嵌入对齐）和对级一致性（提示间相对几何与需求间一致），使独立学习的提示在共享语义空间中可通过向量算术有效混合。推理时通过加权向量平均混合多个提示。

Result: 在任务增量与偏好增量两种持续对齐设置下，Ready2Blend是唯一冻结骨干网络的方法，性能达到MTL联合训练上界的93.1%-98.5%，与最强后训练方法（CPPO、LifeAlign）相当甚至更优，且训练时间少2.6-4.3倍，仅需4个提示令牌；同时支持推理时个性化加权混合与顺序无关的组合。

Conclusion: 将持续对齐从"骨干网络更新"转移到"提示更新"的范式是可行的，组合性正则化是将文本语义几何迁移到提示空间、使独立学习的提示可有效组合的关键。冻结骨干网络配合模块化提示库可实现高效、可组合且顺序无关的终身对齐。

Abstract: Continual alignment requires LLMs to adapt to new requirements without forgetting previously acquired behaviors. Natural-language instructions are flexible and composable but offer only indirect control, whereas post-training provides stronger adaptation at the cost of repeated parameter updates. We introduce Ready2Blend, which combines the flexibility of natural language with learned alignment. AlignFormer maps each requirement to a fixed-length alignment prompt stored in a modular prompt bank, while the backbone and prior prompts remain frozen. Composability regularization transfers the semantic geometry of textual requirements into prompt space, enabling inference-time blending and reweighting. Across two practical continual alignment settings, Ready2Blend is the only frozen-backbone method that matches post-training-based alignment methods, reaching $93.1$-$98.5\%$ of a joint-training reference with competitive retention, while requiring only a few prompt tokens and up to $4.3\times$ less training time. Abstract: Argument Mining (AM) is a critical NLP task that remains significantly under-resourced in Arabic. This paper presents $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$, a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture for argument discourse detection and classification, as our system for Daleel 2026, the inaugural Arabic argument mining shared task. The task requires the identification and classification of argumentative discourse units (ADUs) in debate and editorial this http URL jointly model these two objectives as a token-level sequence labeling task using a BERT-BiLSTM-CRF architecture that combines contextual transformer embeddings with structural transition constraints to support accurate span detection. $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ achieves an F1-score of 72.69 on validation and 73.7 on test data. Our domain-specific analysis shows that models trained exclusively on editorials underperform those trained on debates, a disparity we primarily attribute to the smaller size of the editorial dataset. The code for $\testtt{STAR-Ar}$ is available at ${\href{ this https URL }{\faGithub~TTLab at Daleel 2026}}$

*Dalton Raphael Harmsen,Swier Garst,Thomas van Osch,Zarè Palanciyan,Joaquin Vanschoren*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于语言类型学特征的零计算成本跨语言迁移性估计方法，仅使用免费可得的 Grambank 和 WALS 类型学数据库预测 ATLAS 转移矩阵，无需任何语言模型训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨语言迁移性测量方法（如 ATLAS）需要数百次大规模多语言预训练，计算成本极高。研究旨在探索是否可利用免费类型学数据库低成本预测迁移性，并探究高资源语言的优越地位源于类型学相似性还是数据资源偏差。

Result: 调优随机森林在 LOLO 协议下达到 ρ=0.705、R²=0.49，优于非类型学控制（ρ=0.62）。信号在 LOSO（ρ=0.776）和 LOFO（ρ=0.729）下依然稳健，证明非由文字或语族混淆驱动。Grambank 单独表现优于其与 WALS 的并集（ρ=0.78 vs 0.705），因 WALS 存在过拟合。特征信号高度冗余，单一特征即可达 ρ=0.622。偏差分解显示原始排序中英语第一，但去除资源-文字偏差后马拉地语和菲律宾语跃居首位（p<0.001），揭示高资源排名受资源偏差影响。

Conclusion: 类型学数据库包含廉价且稠密的跨语言迁移信号，可作为零计算筛选工具替代数百次训练运行。迁移性源于众多微小结构对齐的累积效应而非单一特征族。当前基于资源统计的最佳源语言排名存在资源-文字偏差，类型学特征因不涉及资源元数据而成为独立评估视角，质疑了英语作为最优预训练源的理论合理性。

Abstract: Cross-lingual transfer describes how knowledge in a source language benefits a target language. Measuring it quantitatively requires broad multilingual pre-training, as prior work has done with cross-lingual transfer matrices. We ask whether transfer is predictable from freely available typological features, and whether the prominence of high-resource source languages reflects typology or data quality and quantity. We show that typological databases contain cheap and dense signals about cross-lingual transfer. Our typology-only random forest on a 24-language prior-work transfer matrix scores leave-one-language-out $\rho{=}0.705$ and $R^2{=}0.49$, beating a non-typological control at $\rho{=}0.62$, which verifies the ability of typology-only predictions to reconstruct costly measured cross-lingual transfer. The signal survives leave-one-script-out and leave-one-family-out protocols, so script and family confounding do not explain the effect. By decomposing the transfer into a typology term and a resource-and-script bias term, we find the best-source ranking sensitive to this bias. In contrast, typology is not affected by this bias, which makes it a zero-compute screening tool that replaces hundreds of training runs with a model fit. Our code is available \href{ this https URL }{here}.

### [27] [SEPAL: Separated Expert Pairs with Answer-Level Fusion for Reliable LLM Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39645)
*Weijie Ren,Yanwen Zhang,Hao Li,Zhuolin Qi,Hengyi Zhang,Naibo Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SEPAL提出了一种多智能体协作框架，通过三个独立的Actor-Critic团队（Direct、Evidence、Verification）分别执行推理任务，各团队内部进行私有Critic引导的修订，团队之间不共享推理历史，最终仅对最终答案进行多数投票融合。该方法在5个开源模型（2B-8B）和5个问答基准上平均比单对ACC-Collab基线提升1.81个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多智能体协作方法存在两个局限：（1）共享历史的多智能体辩论会让早期错误传播到多个候选答案，侵蚀投票所需的多样性；（2）单对Actor-Critic协作只能优化一个候选答案，缺乏投票所需的独立候选。文章旨在解决"局部修订"与"替代保留"之间的矛盾，在保留修订收益的同时维持候选间的有用差异。

Method: SEPAL框架包含三个独立的Actor-Critic团队，分别承担不同推理目标：Direct（直接推导答案）、Evidence（基于证据/事实）、Verification（独立求解并验证备选项）。每个团队内部进行4轮Critic引导的私有修订，团队间不交换任何推理历史或反馈。训练采用角色特定的SFT初始化Actor，然后基于ACC-Collab的"延续正确性"偏好规则进行Critic DPO和Actor DPO。最终仅对三个团队的最终答案进行多数投票，平局时使用Direct作为固定回退，不引入任何学习型Judge。

Result: 在5个开源模型（Llama-3-8B、Qwen2.5-3B、Gemma-2-2B、Phi-4-mini、Mistral-7B）和5个QA基准（MMLU、BoolQ、BBH、SciQ、ARC）上，SEPAL在25个模型-数据集单元中的24个优于匹配的单对ACC基线，平均宏准确率提升1.81个百分点（范围1.06-2.22）。消融实验表明Critic引导的修订贡献最大增益（Full-R0到Full-R4平均+3.72点），其中第一轮修订就获得了89.2%的总增益。投票结果在21/25的单元中超过最强单角色表现。Oracle-any-role差距达9.81点，表明选择而非生成为主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: SEPAL验证了"私有修订+答案级融合"策略的有效性：修订增益主要来自Critic引导的局部反馈，而多数投票在保留候选差异性的同时提升整体准确率。该方法无需学习型Judge，具有透明性优势。局限在于仅评估了2B-8B规模的短答案QA任务，且为单次确定性运行。未来工作可探索校准路由器和自适应停止规则，以进一步缩小oracle-any-role差距。

Abstract: Multi-agent collaboration lets large language models (LLMs) improve question answering through deliberation and feedback. We introduce SEPAL, which assigns three private Actor-Critic teams to direct reasoning, evidence grounding, and verification. Role-specific training gives the teams different reasoning objectives beyond sampling variation. Each Critic guides revisions within its own team, preventing feedback from carrying errors across candidates. Once revision ends, majority voting combines only the final answers, keeping the reasoning histories separate until the decision. Across five open-weight backbones and five question-answering benchmarks, SEPAL improves mean accuracy by 1.81 percentage points over a matched single Actor-Critic pair, with improvements across all five backbones. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [28] [Stress-Testing LLM Lie Detectors: Role-Play Failures and Spurious Correlations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39807)
*Maximilian von Klinski,Sebastian Lapuschkin,Wojciech Samek,Lennart Bürger*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统性地压力测试了现有LLM谎言检测探针的可靠性，发现它们在反事实角色扮演场景下普遍失效，并提出这些探针实际上追踪的是与"真"虚假伪相关的混淆概念（如指令遵循度和回答可能性）。作者构建了大规模人工审核数据集和三类反相关混淆测试集，并据此提出了一种新的简洁线性探针，在所有压力测试中均表现出最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM展现出日益复杂的说谎与欺骗能力（如伪装对齐、社会工程学），内部状态探针（lie detection probes）成为AI安全研究的热点方向。然而，LLM能够通过角色扮演（role-play）模拟不同信念体系的人物（如阴谋论者），这使得"真"与"假"的定义变得模糊——一个反事实角色所陈述的"谎言"，究竟应按模型默认助手的信念来判断，还是按其所扮演角色的信念来判断？现有探针在训练数据中可能将"真"与某些伪相关概念（如指令遵循度、回答可能性）混淆，导致其在角色扮演场景下不可靠。

Method: 1. 构建反事实角色扮演数据集：包含15种反事实角色（5现实型+5虚构型+5历史型），由3个LLM（Llama 3.3 70B、Gemma 3 27B、Gemma 4 31B）采用贪心解码生成8,916条人工审核的on-policy问答对。2. 设计Shared-Persona Prefill (SPP)变体：将诚实和欺骗回答都预填充在同一反事实角色的系统提示下，消除系统提示本身作为预测线索的混淆。3. 构建三类混淆测试集：似然性（likelihood，通过上下文学习使错误回答更可能）、角色信念（persona belief，使角色私人信念与事实反向相关）、指令遵循度（compliance，使错误回答符合格式要求）。4. 评估8个先前探针并提出新探针：新探针在Marks/Bürger基础上增加了"forced-opposite"训练数据，使指令遵循度与真值反相关。5. 在EOT token处提取残差流激活，训练logistic回归分类器。

Result: 在反事实角色扮演数据集上，大多数先前探针on-policy条件下表现尚可（AUROC 0.86-0.94），但在SPP条件下多数显著下降甚至低于随机水平（如Goldowsky-Dill RepE从0.862降至0.438，Cooney DYL从0.901降至0.328）。混淆测试显示所有先前探针在至少一项测试中失败，特别是在"合规性"混淆测试中全部表现低于随机水平。作者提出的新探针在所有三种模型、两种评估条件及所有三个混淆测试中均达到近乎完美的AUROC（≥0.900），是唯一在所有设置下都不低于0.900的探针。消融研究表明，性能提升主要来自forced-opposite训练数据的加入和EOT token的使用，而非新增的元素符号数据。虚构型角色（如哈利波特巫师、星际迷航联邦公民）对所有探针都最具挑战性，可能因这些虚构世界在预训练数据中与现实世界事实深度纠缠。

Conclusion: 当前LLM真值/谎言检测探针远未达到可靠水平：它们在反事实角色扮演下经常失败，转而追踪与真值仅存在伪相关性的概念（特别是指令遵循度和回答可能性）。本文的核心启示是：探针的训练数据必须使"真"与潜在混淆概念去相关，才能构建真正可靠的探针。本文提出的简单线性探针通过对训练数据中指令遵循度与真值的故意反相关设计，在所有压力测试中取得了最佳性能。然而，作者也指出可能存在更多尚未识别的混淆因素，且结果限于≤70B参数的模型、单轮对话和系统提示诱导的角色，呼吁未来研究构建更广泛的训练数据集并系统搜索混淆因素。

Abstract: Lie detection probes aim to predict from a language model's internal states whether its output is truthful or dishonest. However, role-play complicates what "truth" means for an LLM: language models can adopt a wide range of personas that take very different claims to be true, including personas whose beliefs clearly contradict reality, such as a conspiracy theorist. In this work, we investigate whether lie detection probes reliably flag falsehoods generated under such an anti-factual persona or whether they instead follow the persona's beliefs. We introduce a dataset of 8,916 human-reviewed, on-policy responses from three LLMs adopting anti-factual personas. Evaluating eight probes from prior work, we find that many fail in this setting, particularly when correct and incorrect answers are evaluated under the same persona prompt. To investigate why, we construct three novel confounder datasets in which truth is anti-correlated with a potential confounding concept. Our experiments reveal that many existing probes strongly track concepts that are spuriously correlated with truth in their training data, such as instruction compliance or response likelihood. Based on these findings, we introduce a simple linear probe that achieves the strongest overall performance on both the persona and confounder stress tests. Our results suggest that current lie detection probes are far from reliable and highlight the need for training data in which truth is decorrelated from confounding concepts.

</details>

*Atsuki Yamaguchi,Tatsuro Inaba,Joel Niklaus,Michal Štefánik,Aline Villavicencio,Nikolaos Aletras*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对合成非自然语言数据上的"预预训练"(Pre-pretraining, PPT)进行了首次大规模系统性评估,涵盖5种PPT任务、4种预训练(PT)数据混合、4个模型规模(500M至7B)以及高达1000亿token的PT预算。研究发现PPT的下游性能收益和token效率提升在更大规模下依然存在(例如在3B规模上至少节省210亿PT token),但反驳了此前工作关于PPT效果源于"语法先验"的主张,转而提出PPT的有效性源于其诱导的"长程检索"能力。此外,PPT收益对PT数据混合中代码和数学的比例变化不敏感,仅在完全移除网页文本时消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前的PPT研究仅限于≤1B参数模型、≤2B token PT预算,且主要在网页文本数据上测试。但其核心解释——PPT通过在合成非自然语言数据(如k-Shuffle Dyck括号语言)上预热训练,使模型获得一种"语法先验"从而提升自然语言PT效率——尚未在更大模型规模、更长训练预算和更多样化数据混合(如包含代码和数学)的现实条件下得到验证。本研究旨在回答:在大规模现实条件下,PPT的收益是否仍然存在?其"语法先验"的解释是否仍然成立?

Method: 作者采用SmolLM3架构和分词器,在4个参数规模(500M/1B/3B/7B)上进行实验,使用5种PPT任务(两种形式语言k-Shuffle Dyck和MP-Struct Core、两种无形式语法的结构化合成任务NCA和Set、以及一个域内文本对照Control),在4种PT数据混合(C4纯网页、SmolLM3、OLMo3、Marin)上训练。标准PT预算为210亿token,扩展预算达1000亿token。评估包括10个下游基准测试(阅读理解、科学问答、常识推理、语言建模)、BLiMP语法可接受性测试和逐字检索测试,以检验下游性能、语法能力和长程检索能力三个维度。

Result: 主要结果包括:(1) PPT收益在大规模下持续存在——k-Shuffle Dyck在12个规模-数据混合配对中的9个上提升下游性能平均1.6分,在3B规模Marin上至少节省210亿PT token,收益在7B/1000亿token下仍然为正;(2) PPT收益并非源于"语法先验"——BLiMP语法可接受性测试在12个配对中仅1个获得稳定提升(而下游平均有10个),且随模型规模变化呈现不稳定趋势;(3) PPT实际诱导的是"长程检索"能力——逐字检索NLL在12个配对中全部降低(7个稳定),且下游收益最大的任务(LAMBADA、ReCoRD、HellaSwag)均依赖前文信息;(4) 任何要求从序列中检索特定先前位置的PPT任务均有效(k-Shuffle Dyck、NCA、MP-Struct Core),而仅需追踪已见token的Set任务则使性能下降7.2分;(5) PPT收益对代码和数学比例变化不敏感(数学数据增加13倍不影响收益),但完全移除网页文本时收益消失。

Conclusion: PPT是一种低成本的PT增强方法,其下游性能收益和token效率提升在500M至7B参数规模和最高1000亿token PT预算下仍然持续。然而,此前关于PPT效果源于"语法先验"的解释在大规模下不成立:下游性能提升并未与语法可接受性提升一致对应。相反,有效PPT任务的共同特征是需要从序列中检索特定先前位置(长程检索),而非层级递归结构。PPT收益对PT数据混合的组成方式具有鲁棒性,仅在完全缺少网页文本时才消失。因此,未来的PPT任务设计应直接针对长程检索能力,而非模仿自然语言语法的层级结构。

Abstract: Pre-pretraining (PPT) on synthetic non-natural language data improves token efficiency during language model pre-training (PT). Prior work attributes this gain to a grammatical prior, i.e., a structural inductive bias learned during PPT that transfers to natural language grammar. However, PPT has only been tested on models of at most 1B parameters and PT budgets below 2B tokens on predominantly web text. It is unknown whether PPT is effective at larger scales and under more realistic PT data mixtures that combine diverse sources (e.g., code and math). We therefore present a comprehensive study on PPT spanning five PPT tasks, four PT data mixtures, four parameter scales (500M to 7B), and PT budgets of up to 100B tokens. Our results demonstrate that the downstream performance and token efficiency gains of PPT persist at scale, e.g., saving at least 21B PT tokens at the 3B scale. However, in contrast to prior work, we find no consistent evidence that these gains stem from a grammatical prior. Downstream performance does not consistently align with grammatical acceptability across model sizes. Instead, we find that downstream gains arise from PPT tasks that improve long-range retrieval. Finally, PPT performance gains are robust to how PT data mixtures are composed and diminish only when web text is absent. Overall, PPT is a low-cost addition to PT, and future PPT task design should target long-range retrieval rather than natural language grammar.

</details>


### [30] [When a Kindergartener Solves Calculus: Measuring Capability Leakage in Role-Prompted Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39846)
*Pakhapoom Sarapat,Saksorn Ruangtanusak,Kunat Pipatanakul,Pittawat Taveekitworachai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究角色提示推理模型中的"角色能力泄露"（RCL）现象，即模型在扮演低能力角色（如幼儿园学生）时仍能生成正确答案，表现出超出角色能力边界的能力。作者构建了基于标准化课程基准 RoleCapBench，对三个开源推理模型在六种教育角色和四种评估水平下进行测试，发现标准角色提示下模型角色语言得分为1.218–1.389，但超角色准确率高达0.811–0.898，RCL现象在多种提示条件下持续存在。提出的 Injection 推理时干预方法通过结合角色特定能力指南和预填充响应前缀，使超角色准确率降低最多0.562，同时保持角色内准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角色提示是让通用大语言模型适应学生、角色、合成用户模拟等的常用接口，但现有角色扮演评估主要关注语言风格、角色知识和对话一致性，鲜有研究关注模型在扮演特定角色时是否真正约束其能力边界。例如，让模型扮演幼儿园学生角色时，它不应具备解答微积分问题的能力。然而，模型可能在生成符合角色的语言同时，仍展现超出该角色应有能力的能力水平，这种"角色能力泄露"对教育模拟、用户模拟等应用场景构成风险。

Method: 1. 构建 RoleCapBench 基准：基于标准化教育考试（纽约州小学到8年级考试、高中Regents考试、A-Level考试），包含1,568道四选一选择题，涵盖四个课程水平（小学、初中、高中、A-Level）和六个教育角色（幼儿园到大学教师）。2. 设计八种提示变体：Identity、Description、CoT、Guideline、Explicit-IDK、Syllabus、Injection、Injection-Syllabus，系统性地检验不同提示设计对RCL的影响。3. 提出 Injection 方法：将能力指南与预填充的角色提醒响应前缀结合，引导模型在推理前重新审视自身角色和能力边界。4. 使用三类指标评估：任务准确率（TA）、角色内准确率（IA）、超角色准确率（AA）以及由GPT-OSS-20B评判的角色语言（RV）、能力一致性（CC）、推理连贯性（RC）。

Result: 1. 标准角色提示（Identity）下，三个模型的超角色准确率均维持在0.811–0.898，角色语言得分1.218–1.389，表明模型可生成风格上符合角色的文本，却持续展现远超角色的能力。2. 详细的提示策略（Guideline、Explicit-IDK）可降低Gemma和Qwen的超角色准确率（最低降至0.372和0.434），但对OLMo几乎无效（仍维持在0.802–0.815）。3. Injection方法显著降低超角色准确率：Gemma降低0.346，Qwen降低0.371，OLMo降低0.562，同时角色内准确率降幅控制在0.058以内（OLMo除外，降幅0.370）。4. Injection-Syllabus进一步在注入课程描述基础上恢复角色内准确率，特别是对OLMo从0.511提升至0.684。5. 模型规模扩大（Gemma-26B和31B）并未缓解RCL现象。6. 提示设计在能力控制上有效，但会牺牲角色语言一致性（角色语音分数下降）；Gemma在Explicit-IDK下从1.389降至1.122。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了角色提示推理模型中普遍存在的"角色能力泄露"现象，证明模型能生成风格上令人信服的角色内文本，却持续展现超出角色应有能力的能力水平。RoleCapBench基准提供了基于标准化课程的明确能力边界，使RCL可被系统测量。提示工程的缓解效果高度依赖模型架构：Gemma和Qwen对能力约束指令有响应，但OLMo几乎不变。RCL的根本局限在于角色提示本质上仅作为"软先验"，除非通过显式能力约束或训练时干预加以强化，否则无法可靠地约束模型能力。研究还警示了基于角色的能力控制可能带来的安全风险：训练模型遵循能力受限提示可能建立战略性欠表现或评估规避的攻击面。推理时能力控制需要两步：激活角色定位和确定知识边界。未来工作应探索更广泛的领域和更可靠的缓解方法。

Abstract: We investigate the problem of role-capability leakage (RCL), in which a role-prompted reasoning model generates convincing in-role text while continuing to exhibit capabilities on benchmarks that exceed those implied by the assigned role. For example, when a model is prompted to assume the role of a kindergarten student, one might expect its performance on a mathematics benchmark to reflect kindergarten-level ability rather than expert-level proficiency in solving calculus problems. We introduce RoleCapBench, a curriculum-grounded benchmark for evaluating RCL across six educational roles and four assessment levels spanning elementary school through A-level, and use it to evaluate three open-weight reasoning models. We find that although the models can generate stylistically convincing in-role responses, they consistently fail to align their underlying capabilities with their assigned roles. Naive role prompting yields strong role-voice scores of 1.218--1.389 while retaining above-role accuracy of 0.811--0.898. RCL persists across a range of prompting conditions, including prompts that explicitly instruct the model to match the role's capability level. To mitigate this problem, we propose Injection, an inference-time intervention that combines explicit, role-specific capability guidelines with a guiding prefilled response prefix. Injection improves role-capability alignment across models, reducing above-role accuracy by up to 0.562 while preserving in-role accuracy with a marginal drop of less than 0.058 across most models. All artifacts, including scripts and evaluation data, will be released upon acceptance.

### [31] [OPSRD: On-Policy Self-Role Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39884)
*Weijie Ren,Yanwen Zhang,Hao Li,Zhuolin Qi,Hengyi Zhang,Naibo Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Role prompting elicits specialized behavior from large language models through an expert identity, offering a lightweight way to guide reasoning on demanding tasks. However, evaluating or distilling complete role-prompted answers can miss useful next-token preferences when the sampled solution remains incorrect. Transferring these preferences also requires an objective that reaches alternatives the student rarely predicts. We introduce OPSRD, which uses a fixed expert role as privileged teaching context for on-policy self-distillation without reference solutions. A role-free student generates a trajectory, and a frozen instance of the same base model supplies role-conditioned distributions on its exact prefixes, exposing alternatives beyond the sampled continuation. Teacher-weighted forward KL targets alternatives the student underestimates, with clipping to limit individual vocabulary contributions. Supervision is restricted to the highest-entropy half of student positions, concentrating learning where predictions are uncertain. Experiments on three competition-math benchmarks with Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B show improvements over the base models without role prompts at inference. Forward KL achieves the highest macro-averaged accuracy among the three evaluated divergences at every scale. Code is available at this https URL .

### [32] [LEAP: Learned Block-wise Evidence Retrieval for Long Audio-Video Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39938)
*Juyi Lin,Zhiqiang Lao,Jiali Cui,Lin Zhao,Pu Zhao,Dichang Zhang,Arman Akbari,Yu Qi,Xinru Jiang,Yanzhi Wang,Heather Yu,Liang Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Hour-scale audio-visual question answering is constrained by a context dilemma: dense whole-recording encoding rapidly exhausts context limits, whereas uniform temporal compression severely dilutes fine-grained acoustic and visual evidence. We introduce LEAP, a framework where the model retrieves its own evidence without placing the whole recording in one context. LEAP divides a recording into fixed-duration blocks, applying a lightweight localization pass to each block to score short candidate windows. The highest-ranked windows are pooled and re-encoded in a single bounded answer pass. Consequently, the answer input and peak context remain independent of the recording duration. By decoupling evidence localization from reasoning, our framework can localize candidate temporal windows over pre-computed transcripts without decoding media frames, while preserving fine-grained visual and non-speech evidence by routing the final answering pass over raw audio-visual streams. LEAP trains both stages: a localization LoRA improves the selected windows, and an answer LoRA improves the answers read from the same windows. The block grid natively supports causal queries, enabling LEAP to support streaming inference without streaming-specific training. Across several AVQA benchmarks, LEAP improves over the Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B baseline by 4.5-16.8%, and transfers to a second omni-modal backbone, MiniCPM-o 4.5, surpassing its published results by 3.1-13.0%.

### [33] [Overview of BioASQ 2026: The fourteenth BioASQ Challenge on Large-Scale Biomedical Semantic Indexing and Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39975)

TL;DR: This paper presents an overview of the fourteenth edition of the BioASQ challenge, organized in the context of the Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum (CLEF) 2026. BioASQ is an international challenge series that supports progress in biomedical language processing tasks ranging from semantic indexing and information extraction to question answering and summarization. In 2026, BioASQ included six shared tasks: a) Task 14b on biomedical semantic question answering. b) Task Synergy14 on question answering for developing biomedical top- ics. c) Task MultiClinSum-2 on multilingual clinical summarization. d) Task BioNNE-R on extracting relations between nested named entities in Russian and English. e) Task ELCardioCC on clinical coding in cardiology. f) Task GutBrainIE on gut-brain interplay information extrac- tion. Across these six tasks, 87 distinct teams participated, submitting more than 1000 runs overall. As in previous editions, several submissions reached competitive performance, reflecting the continued progress of state-of-the-art methods across biomedical language processing tasks.

### [34] [Mid-Harness: Scaling Actions Between Model and Harness for Terminal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39982)
*Minki Kang,Ryo Hachiuma,Shaokun Zhang,Subhashree Radhakrishnan,Yonggan Fu,Jindong Jiang,Mingjie Liu,Ehsan Hosseini-Asl,Yi Dong,Yu-Chiang Frank Wang,Byung-Kwan Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Terminal agents act through stochastic model generations, yet the ability to generate a useful action does not ensure its reliable execution. A poor command (e.g., wrong package install) can change the environment in ways that hinder subsequent progress, even when the model could generate a better alternative. We investigate whether allocating test-time compute at the model-harness boundary can improve action reliability and trajectory success, and what makes this allocation effective. To study these questions, we introduce Mid-Harness, which samples and verifies candidate actions before forwarding one for execution, while keeping the generator and harness unchanged. With a TMAX-9B generator, more action sampling yields little benefit under weak verification, whereas a capable verifier can exploit useful alternatives from the same generator. On TerminalBench-Lite, a GPT-5.6 Sol verifier raises Pass@1 from 50.00% for the base agent to 68.03% with 8 sampled actions. When the same TMAX-9B model serves as the verifier, pairwise verification performs best among the evaluated verification mechanisms. Distilling responses from the stronger verifier into TMAX-9B further improves Pass@1, while leaving the action generator unchanged. With TMAX-9B on TerminalBench-Lite, combining action and trajectory scaling reaches higher success at lower estimated token cost than generating more trajectories alone. Mid-Harness also improves performance across additional models, benchmarks, and harnesses. These findings identify action scaling as a promising target for test-time compute scaling in terminal agents.

### [35] [On the (In)effectiveness of AMR Augmentation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40121)
*Hoa Quynh Nhung Nguyen,Jacopo Staiano,Michael Sullivan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: While Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) has historically improved performance on a range of NLP tasks, the benefit---or lack thereof---of AMR augmentation for modern LLMs is thus far unclear. In this paper, we attempt to reproduce recent work that reported substantial downstream gains from AMR augmentation, finding that these are likely due to specific choices in the experimental settings used: using a consistent and unified protocol for hyperparameter selection, we observe that text-only baselines consistently match or exceed the performance of AMR-augmented models. To investigate this null result, we introduce a perplexity-based probe measuring the degree to which AMR provides an LLM with supplemental relational knowledge not already available to the model. We find that AMR augmentation does not help LLMs improve their understanding of relational content in the sentence, indicating that augmenting these models with AMR offers no clear benefit on downstream tasks.

### [36] [SCB: SpeechConversationBench for Evaluating Multi-Turn Reasoning in Speech-to-Speech Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40198)
*Kanpat Vesessook,Saksorn Ruangtanusak*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Speech-to-speech systems must solve tasks whose requirements emerge across conversational turns. We introduce SpeechConversationBench (SCB), a focused evaluation of spoken mathematical reasoning using 103 sharded GSM8K problems. The framework compares the original problem delivered in one turn (full), its concatenated information shards delivered together (concat), and incremental spoken disclosure across turns (sharded). We report final-answer accuracy for four commercial speech systems and LEGO, a proprietary speech pipeline developed internally by the SCBX Innovation Lab team with explicit conversational context management. Relative to concat, sharded accuracy decreases by 5.0-25.3 percentage points across the four commercial systems. LEGO achieves 77.5 percent accuracy in all three conditions, compared with 76.6 percent sharded accuracy for GPT-4o Realtime. The two single-turn baselines distinguish sensitivity to problem reformulation from the additional challenges introduced by incremental spoken interaction.

### [37] [Linguistic Loopholes in LLM Unlearning: From a 174-Language Benchmark to Coverage-Aware Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40286)
*Tyler Skow,Shravan Chaudhari,Rama Chellappa,Abhay Yadav*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Unlearning a fact in one language does not guarantee its removal in others as changing the query or even the requested answer language can reopen seemingly forgotten knowledge -- a cross-lingual loophole. The most straightforward solution to this challenge -- unlearning in all languages -- is neither scalable nor desirable as it amplifies damage to unrelated model capabilities. We introduce the task of language budgeted multilingual unlearning where the goal is to select a subset of languages that maximizes cross-lingual erasure. To study this task we introduce the Cross-Lingual Unlearning Tensor, an unlearning benchmark that spans 174 language--script pairs and 25 atomic paraphrase types to examine when forgetting generalizes across linguistic expressions of the same knowledge. We further propose COVER, which selects source languages to maximize predicted COVERage of languages receiving no forget supervision, enabling unlearning on a language budget. Surprisingly, we find naively selecting strong individual sources does not reliably compose into strong source sets motivating our development of COVER. At deployment COVER only requires benign calibration data and access to the frozen model. Across three model families and two disjoint forget sets, COVER reduces mean held-out residual access by 7.8--27.3% relative to uniform source selection. We find these gains extend beyond synthetic benchmarks to real news documents in low-resource language settings using human translated data from the Low Resource Languages for Emergent Incidents (LORELEI) corpus.

### [38] [TomasuLLM: Out-of-Order Speculative Execution for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38201)
*Jiangnan Yu,Ceyu Xu,Mengming Li,Shiyu Huang,Yiran Xia,Jian Weng,Hui Xue,Haohui Mai,Yuan Xie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Long-running tools can dominate coding-agent latency: compilers, test suites, and repository commands take seconds to minutes while the agent idles. This observation stall presents the same tension that drove out-of-order processors -- asequential interface hides work that can be predicted and started early, but a speculative result may become visible only after it and every earlier step have been validated. We present TomasuLLM, a runtime that executes agent tool calls out of trajectory order while preserving task-execution correctness. It drafts future actions, runs them in isolated copy-on-write sandboxes, traces their dependencies and effects, and commits results in trajectory order only after validation against committed state. Across three benchmarks spanning sub-second to minutes-long tool calls, TomasuLLM improves the reported benchmark means and scales with tool latency: 1.31x on 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, 1.35x on 28 Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks, and 1.27x matched progress on 18 SWE-Marathon sessions. Across 4,010 audited commit-validation records, it produces zero false accepts.

### [39] [The System Prompt Illusion: How Instruction Preambles Modify Computation in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38205)
*Muhammad Usama,Dong Eui Chang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: System prompts are the primary lever practitioners use to control language model behavior, yet what they actually do to the computation inside the transformer remains poorly understood. Across 17 instruction-tuned models spanning 8 architecture families and 1.5B to 72B parameters, we use Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) to compare layer-wise representations under 20 system prompts in five functional categories. Effects are layer-selective and instruction-type-dependent: persona and formatting instructions deeply restructure intermediate representations, while safety instructions barely move them, producing changes statistically indistinguishable from a minimal baseline. Restrictive safety instructions and explicitly permissive ones ("you have no restrictions") engage near-identical computational pathways (mean CKA correlation 0.997), and this persists at commercial scale, where safety penetration remains below 10% even at 70B-72B. A linear probing baseline exposes the mechanism: the model encodes prompt category at every layer but restructures its computation only at a small subset, so the prompt is reliably "seen" but, for safety, not deeply "acted upon." Causal activation patching confirms these layers mediate behavioral change, and representational depth predicts behavioral effect size across the full 17-model cohort (Spearman rho = 0.761, p < 0.001). The findings provide a mechanistic explanation for the persistent jailbreak vulnerability of system-prompt-based safety. Code: this https URL

### [40] [TutlAit v1: a crowdsourced Moroccan Tamazight speech dataset with Arabic transcriptions and regional accent labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38219)
*Mohamed-Amine Chadi,Ezzahra Ait El Arbi,Ismail Khayoub,Aymane Fadili,Yassine Ennhili,Jadjigua Bouali,Hanane Inhid,Mohammed Ameksa,Hajar Mousannif*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Tamazight (Amazigh) is, together with Arabic, one of the two official languages of Morocco, yet it remains severely under-resourced for speech technology: pub licly available labelled audio is scarce, generally lacks information on the regional variety spoken, and is often of uneven transcription quality. This article describes the TutlAit dataset, a corpus of Moroccan Tamazight speech paired with Modern Standard Arabic text and explicit regional accent labels. The data were collected with TutlAit, a purpose-built crowdsourcing web application (React 18 front end, Django 5 / Django REST Framework back-end, PostgreSQL database). Native speakers recruited through targeted LinkedIn and Instagram campaigns created an account, declared their regional variety (Atlas, Souss, Rif or other) and demographic information, and then contributed through two workflows: Text-to Audio, in which an Arabic sentence is displayed and the volunteer records its oral Tamazight rendering in the browser, and Audio-to-Text, in which a Tamazight excerpt is played and the volunteer types its Arabic transcription. A complemen tary set of segments was obtained from freely accessible Tamazight audiovisual media, segmented and annotated with ELAN and imported through a bulk CSV/ZIP pipeline. Every upload is converted server-side to 16kHz mono WAV, hashed with SHA-256 for duplicate rejection, checked for duration bounds and validated by an administrator. The dataset contains 13,384 audio files totalling 75,231 seconds (approximately 20.9 hours, about 3.01GB). The Atlas variety accounts for 9,956 files (14.08h) and the Souss variety for 3,378 files (6.75h); small Rif (22 files) and Kabyle (28 files) subsets are also included. The corpus can be reused for speech recognition, speech translation and accent identification for Moroccan Tamazight.

### [41] [Conformal Factuality Control for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38222)
*Muhammad Aimal Rehman,Chi-Kuang Yeh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can ground large language models in external evidence, but retrieved context does not guarantee that generated claims are factually supported. This problem is especially relevant in multi-hop RAG, where retrieval and reasoning proceed through multiple dependent stages. We study whether claim-level conformal factuality control, previously developed for RAG, remains effective in this setting. We apply split-conformal claim filtering to multi-hop RAG and evaluate it on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA using Llama 3.1 8B and GPT-4o-mini, together with a single-hop reference experiment. Across all six multi-hop model-dataset configurations, increasingly stringent conformal targets consistently increase the fraction of responses whose retained claims are fully supported. At the 95% target, this rate ranges from 95.80% to 97.20%, compared with 55.60%-76.03% without filtering. However, the improvement is strongly selective: only 4.41%-31.09% of generated claims are retained and 9.70%-51.40% of responses remain non-empty at the 95% target. These results show that conformal factuality extends to multi-hop RAG, while demonstrating that nominal reliability must be interpreted jointly with claim retention and abstention.
