TL;DR: FIGS是一个双轴评估框架，使用10轮自适应对话模拟器，通过500个多轮场景独立评估大语言模型的"谄媚性"（Sycophancy，对事实立场的把控）与"校准性共情"（Calibrated Validation，对用户情感披露的恰当回应），以揭示当前模型在诚实与共情之间难以兼顾的核心矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估多采用单轮或固定脚本测试，无法捕捉真实多轮对话中随用户反复施压而逐渐浮现的谄媚行为；此外，单轴评估常将"共情"误判为"屈服"，可能驱使模型矫枉过正，陷入冷漠的"家长式陷阱"（paternalism trap）。本文旨在构建一个能同时衡量事实定力与恰当共情的真实多轮评估基准。

Method: 1) 提出双轴分类体系：S轴（Sycophancy，7条规则）评估事实立场把控，分S1（立场形成与修正）与S2（内容与清晰度）两层；V轴（Calibrated Validation，3条规则）评估对用户披露情感/处境的恰当回应。2) 构建500个冻结的多轮场景（390个S轴 + 110个V轴），覆盖6个日常领域与3个严重等级，由自适应用户模拟器（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）执行10轮对话。3) 采用固定LLM评委（GLM-5.3-Flash），通过两阶段打分（先1-4严重度，再标定违规规则）；评委与人类标注一致性QWK达0.75（S轴）/0.70（V轴），超过人类标注者间一致性。4) 评估8个主流模型在baseline、factual（强调准确性）、optimal（双轴平衡）三种系统提示下的表现。

Result: 主要发现：1) 基线下模型谄媚失败率26.2%–64.4%，而V轴失败率普遍低于5.5%；94%的谄媚失败出现在首轮回复之后。2) factual提示显著降低谄媚失败率（所有模型下降24–57点），代价是7/8模型的V轴失败率显著上升（最高从5.5%升至41.8%），且新引入的V轴失败更严重（51%为3或4级），即"家长式陷阱"。3) optimal提示可在4个模型上将谄媚降低一半以上同时保持V轴失败率不高于基线。4) 与SycEval、SYCON、ELEPHANT等基准的对比实验显示，FIGS是首个能区分"合理修正"与"屈服"、区分"恰当共情"与"谄媚"的评估框架。

Conclusion: FIGS揭示了当前LLM在多轮对话中面临的核心张力：保持事实定力与提供恰当共情之间存在系统性权衡。简单的"冷漠无益"提示化指令（fact-grounded）虽能削弱谄媚，却诱发"家长式陷阱"——即冷漠的家长式态度；而针对双轴设计的提示可在大幅削弱谄媚的同时不付出共情代价。作者将FIGS作为冻结的留出评估集而非训练目标发布，以避免Goodhart效应。

Abstract: Large language models frequently fail to balance staying truthful with being supportive. They often exhibit sycophancy in responses to users, agreeing with false claims, offering unwarranted flattery, and giving advice skewed toward users' expressed views. In reality, sycophancy rarely happens in a single exchange; it may emerge organically as users repeatedly insist or subtly steer the dialogue over time. Current evaluations, however, rely on rigid, single-turn tests or fixed scripts that fail to capture these natural dynamics. Furthermore, these benchmarks often mistake showing basic empathy for yielding, penalizing models for acknowledging a user's feeling. This view may drive future models to over-correct into cold, dismissive rigidity. To address this gap, we introduce FIGS (Factual Integrity and Grounded Support), a dual-axis evaluation framework built around extended, realistic dialogue. We use an adaptive 10-turn conversational simulator that dynamically challenges the target model, reflecting how users repeat requests, push back, or steer a conversation toward a preferred answer. To accurately evaluate these trajectories, we apply a taxonomy that strictly separates Sycophancy (whether the model holds firm to the truth and keeps its praise proportional) from Calibrated Validation (showing empathetic understanding of the user's feelings without overdoing it). We release our complete testing environment, including 500 diverse multi-turn scenarios and an automated judge. Our evaluation of leading models reveals a consistent trade-off: over the course of a sustained interaction, current systems either slowly drift to sycophancy or over-correct into robotic detachment. This demonstrates that balancing honesty with appropriate support throughout a natural conversation remains a critical, unsolved challenge.

</details>


### [286] [Completion-Aware Cross-Fidelity Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Line Bus Holding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39868)
*Yifan Zhang,Qifan Zhang,Liang Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究跨保真度离线到在线强化学习在多线公交驻站控制中的应用,针对H2O RL中廉价在线仿真器与目标仿真器之间在转移和事件持续时间动力学上的差异,提出一个完成度感知的驻站安全储备机制,在降低广义乘客时间的同时避免乘客旅程不完整。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实际运营的公交车队上进行探索性强化学习不现实,而仅从历史数据训练的策略无法获取新经验。H2O(混合离线-在线)RL将固定目标回放与仿真器交互相结合,但廉价的在线仿真器在转移和事件持续时间动力学上可能与目标不同。作者研究多线公交驻站控制的跨保真度问题,并解决一种失败模式:较低的广义乘客时间与不完整的乘客旅程共存。

Method: 1) 将异步驻站问题建模为24,000秒的时序半马尔可夫决策过程(SMDP),采用精确的广义乘客时间核算和混合离散-连续动作。2) 使用SUMO生成的包含3,284,718个转移、240个回合、8种行为策略和30个环境单元的不可变离线数据集。3) 改进的H2O+框架:通过隐式Q学习(IQL)初始化,在线仿真器中继续训练25,000个决策事件。4) 完成度安全储备:在低负载尾部车辆且存在剩余需求的状态下,将物理驻站时间提升至60秒。5) 形式化确认:使用1,350个全新的SUMO回合(10个独立环境块、3个需求水平、5个训练种子、45种固定物理行为)进行精确符号检验。

Result: 在1,350个全新SUMO回合上,相对于直接父策略,完成度增强策略将每名离港乘客的广义乘客时间从2,484.86秒降至2,392.73秒(-92.12秒,-3.71%),将完成率从0.96185提升至0.96650(+0.00466),将未完成乘客从655.42人降至578.20人(-77.22人)。在所有10个独立块中,主终点和完成度非劣效性检验(0.003裕度)均通过;单侧精确符号检验p值均为0.0009766。在所有需求水平和训练种子上效应方向一致。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了一个固定的完成度感知储备相对于其直接父策略改善了广义乘客时间和完成率;跨10个独立环境块、3个需求水平和5个训练种子均方向一致。然而,确认的声明仅限于此固定候选策略与其固定直接父策略在仿真器到仿真器端点评估中的比较。未来工作应统一训练和评估运行时,收集更多独立环境单元,将完成度纳入学习目标,并对固定策略进行时间保留的操作记录验证。

Abstract: Exploratory reinforcement learning (RL) on an operating bus fleet is impractical,while policies trained only from historical data cannot acquire new experience. Hybrid Offline-and-Online (H2O) RL combines fixed target replay with simulator interaction, but the inexpensive online simulator can differ from the target in transition and event-duration dynamics. We study this cross-fidelity problem for multi-line bus holding and address a failure mode in which lower generalized passenger time coexists with incomplete passenger journeys.

</details>


### [287] [GrammarRL: Effective Grammar-Constrained Decoding via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39869)
*Gabriele Tuccio,Antonino Furnari,Aldo Gangemi,Misael Mongiov\`ı*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GrammarRL是一种无标注的强化学习方法，通过双向自监督奖励（直接奖励+反向奖励）和RLOO策略优化，使语言模型在语法约束解码下生成语义质量更高的输出，且推理时只需贪心解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语法约束解码虽保证形式正确性，但当模型偏好的输出与约束语法不一致时（尤其是提示信息不足或模型指令跟随能力有限时），会严重损害语义质量。现有推理时搜索方法（beam search、后验近似）计算成本高，而序列级概率并非语义质量的可靠代理。因此需要在无标注数据下，将序列级偏好提前学习到模型参数中。

Method: 1）策略生成N个语法约束采样候选+1个beam search top-1候选；2）冻结参考模型π_ref计算双向奖励：直接奖励R_direct衡量输出y在给定输入x下的似然，反向奖励R_reverse衡量从y重建x的似然（noisy-channel）；3）用RLOO（Leave-One-Out）计算优势函数A^(i)=r^(i)-其他候选均值；4）损失函数结合策略梯度项和KL正则化项（β=0.02），通过LoRA适配器训练策略；5）推理时仅使用语法约束贪心解码，无需额外搜索。

Result: 在三个结构化生成任务（手语gloss翻译、层次分类WoS、命名实体识别CoNLL）上，使用1B-8B的Llama模型，GrammarRL相比冻结基线平均提升9.8分（最高22.8 BLEU）；在两个任务上匹配或超越beam search；在Gloss和CoNLL上匹配或超越需要10倍生成长度的采样后验近似方法（importance sampling和SMC）。消融实验表明直接奖励和反向奖励互补：单一奖励可能低于基线，组合（λ=0.5）则在所有任务上一致优于基线。最佳λ因任务而异。

Conclusion: GrammarRL成功地将序列级偏好通过无标签强化学习"摊销"到模型参数中，使推理时仅需贪心解码即可获得高质量的语法约束输出。双向奖励设计有效解决了直接奖励导致的"无信息输出"和反向奖励导致的"结构陷阱token"两种退化模式。未来方向包括与后验近似方法结合（GrammarRL作为更好的proposal）、自适应λ、扩展到更丰富约束（如编程语言）。

Abstract: Grammar-constrained generation guarantees syntactic validity, but can substantially degrade semantic quality when the model's preferred outputs are poorly aligned with the imposed grammar. This trade-off is particularly severe when the prompt is underspecified or the model has limited instruction-following ability. Beam search can partially mitigate these failures by exploring multiple valid sequences, but its computational cost grows with beam width, while sequence-level probability is only an imperfect proxy for semantic quality. We introduce GrammarRL, a label-free reinforcement learning method that adapts language models to grammar constraints without requiring annotated data. GrammarRL optimizes the model using two complementary self-supervised rewards derived from its own likelihoods: a direct reward, measuring how likely the constrained output is given the input, and a reverse reward, measuring how well the input can be reconstructed from the generated output. We optimize these rewards with a Reinforce Leave-One-Out (RLOO) objective over groups of grammar-constrained rollouts, augmented with the top-1 beam-search hypothesis and regularized towards a frozen base model. We evaluate GrammarRL on sign language gloss translation, hierarchical text classification, and named entity recognition using Llama models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters. GrammarRL consistently outperforms constrained greedy decoding, with an average improvement of 9.8 points and gains of up to 22.8 BLEU. It matches or outperforms beam search on two of the three tasks while preserving greedy-decoding inference cost. Ablations further show that the two rewards are complementary: either reward alone can underperform the untrained baseline, whereas their combination consistently improves upon it.

</details>


### [288] [OSWorld-Science: A Benchmark of Computer Use Agents for Learning and Using Scientific Software](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39903)
*Dingyuan Dai,Heli Qi,Lei Liu,Yinxi Li,Baiding Chen,Zijun Dou,Qingcheng Zeng,Qi Kang,Oliver Sun,Eric Wang,Bo Zhou,Haixin Wang,Yufan Du,Shi Bo,Ruihan Lin,Mengqi Yuan,Dunjie Lu,Steven Dillmann,Yiming Shi,Tina Su,Amy Xin,Minghao Liu,Xi Wang,Xu Huang,Ge Zhang,Pengyu Nie,Zhen Yang,Jie Tang,Juanzi Li,Weihao Xuan,Tianyu Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OSWorld-Science 是一个用于评估计算机使用代理（CUA）在科学研究软件上操作能力的基准测试。它包含146个跨七个科学领域的高质量任务，支持多语言，并提供基于工件（artifact-based）的评估方法和专门的代理框架（harness）。实验表明，即使是最先进的VLM驱动代理，在科学软件任务上也面临巨大挑战，最强模型在困难任务上的成功率仅约40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的计算机使用代理基准（如WebArena、OSWorld）主要关注通用桌面任务，而科学研究软件具有专业性强、界面复杂、需要生成可验证的科学工件等特点。现有评估未能充分捕捉科学家关注的科学价值、异构输出的统一评估、以及代理框架（harness）本身对性能的影响等关键问题。

Method: 1. 任务构建：与领域专家合作设计146个任务，覆盖化学、医学、生物学、物理学、地理信息、统计学、语言学和神经科学七大领域；采用"专家提案"和"人机协同设计"两种方式。2. 评估方法：基于执行的评估器检查环境状态和生成的工件（分子结构、分割掩码、图表、数值结果），支持部分得分。3. 代理框架：整合模型适配器、交互循环控制、轨迹日志，支持不同VLM和交互策略的比较。4. 任务形式化：将科学计算任务定义为目标条件化的POMDP，奖励函数在[0,1]范围内。5. 消融实验：在23个QuPath任务上研究了推理努力、历史窗口长度和任务语言三个因素的影响。

Result: 1. 整体性能：12个VLM中，Claude Fable 5.1表现最佳（73.7%，每任务$6.5），GPT-6 Astra次之（57.4%，每任务$7.7），最强模型在困难子集上成功率仅约40%。2. 失败分析：约74%的运行未能产出可评分的工件；大多数失败不是因为推理错误而是因交互层问题（坐标帧不匹配、动作未生效）或预算耗尽。3. 消融发现：增加推理努力对Opus 5有效（59.7% at max），但对Sonnet 5收益有限；历史窗口增至w=10时性能最优；不同语言对结果影响有限。4. 交互模式：统计任务中86.7%的操作通过终端完成，仅10个运行使用了SAS/RStudio；应用模式运行平均多花30步、得分低23.6%。5. 关键洞察：自我一致性验证不足以捕获错误（如化学任务的立体化学错误），需要独立于代理自身假设的验证。6. 各领域分析显示化学是最困难的领域（最强模型仅44%），EEG表现差异大，地理信息中4个模型因坐标帧不匹配完全失败。

Conclusion: 当前最先进的VLM驱动的计算机使用代理在操作专业科学软件方面仍面临重大挑战，尤其是在化学等需要精确操作和验证的领域。简单的策略如增加推理努力或扩展上下文窗口无法有效解决根本问题。研究应聚焦于开发专门的科学代理，包括改进代理框架、加强交互层可靠性（如坐标帧校准）、以及实现独立于代理自身假设的验证机制。未来的基准设计应确保任务真正需要目标应用程序，并加强可执行检查。

Abstract: Scientific software presents a demanding test for computer-using agents based on visual language models (VLMs): completing a research workflow requires interpreting specialized interfaces, manipulating scientific objects, and producing verifiable results. We thus introduce OSWorld-Science, a benchmark and evaluation environment that combines scientifically meaningful tasks, artifact-based evaluation, and an efficient agent harness for studying computer use in the scientific domain. The benchmark contains 12 VLMs and 146 high-quality tasks across several scientific domains and software configurations, covering workflows such as molecular drawing and retrosynthesis, pathology image analysis, statistical computing, and physical simulation. Tasks are developed through expert proposals and iterative human--AI co-design, with selection guided by scientific value and difficulty. Task-specific execution-based evaluators inspect application states and generated artifacts, including molecular structures, segmentation masks, plots, and numerical results, and award partial credit for incomplete outcomes. Our special harness integrates model adapters, interaction-loop control, and trajectory logging to support comparisons of models and interaction strategies. Our results show that current state-of-the-art VLMs with a strong harness still face challenges in addressing key questions in the scientific domains. We also analyze the benchmarking results across multi-linguistics, reasoning efforts, context length and other factors and derive several important conclusions and directions to assist future development. Overall, we provide an integrated framework connecting expert-defined scientific goals to verifiable software outcomes, enabling systematic evaluation of both agent capabilities and harness design in scientific workflows.

</details>


### [289] [ConflictGuide: AutoResearch Improves When Competing Behaviors Are Made Visible](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39933)
*Binqian Xu,Qiran Zou,Xiangbo Shu,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ConflictGuide是一种两阶段AutoResearch框架，通过引入竞争行为反馈（而非仅依赖标量任务指标）来改进LLM驱动的模型自动演化。它识别模型特定的设计冲突，并通过定制探针衡量相互竞争的行为，在标量反馈探索后引导提案朝冲突缓解方向发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AutoResearch系统依赖标量任务性能反馈进行迭代代码编辑，但标量反馈无法揭示代码编辑如何影响相互竞争的行为（改进一个行为可能损害另一个）。在任务增益趋于平缓时，这种盲区限制了进一步进展。需要一种方法来揭示编辑对竞争行为的差异化影响，从而实现持续的改进。

Method: 方法包含两个核心组件：(1) ConflictGuide-Skill，基于文献根-轴-机制分类法（9个根、6个轴、110个机制）识别模型特定冲突，并设计可量化的探针来衡量竞争行为；(2) 两阶段演化流程：Stage I使用标量任务反馈进行广泛探索；Stage II引入探针反馈引导提案朝冲突缓解方向，并通过辅助保留路径（边际任务增益+探针证明足够缓解）来过滤编辑。探针需经过资格验证，使用固定的评估数据和预校准阈值。

Result: 在5个模型系列（SpecB-FNO、SNGP、GCNII、ESN、TCM-Lite）上，ConflictGuide相比标量AutoResearch将任务错误降低最多28%、冲突相关错误降低最多14%。联合改进的提案比例从7.2%提升至13.1%，联合退化从29.0%降至20.7%。从共同分支点出发，ConflictGuide在标量方法趋于平缓后仍能继续改进。该方法在Kimi K2.7 Code和AIDE框架下也能泛化。Stage I预算100次迭代、Stage II 100次迭代为最佳平衡点。

Conclusion: ConflictGuide通过使竞争行为对AutoResearch智能体可见来提升模型演化效果。它能识别模型特定的设计冲突、量化竞争行为、并在标量增益趋于平缓后通过探针引导的提案和保留机制实现持续改进。该方法适用于多种架构和代码智能体，但依赖于足够的模型特定证据来识别冲突并设计有效探针。未来工作包括自适应探针反馈时机、多冲突交互分析以及系统性的适用性评估。

Abstract: When designing machine learning models, desirable properties are often in tension: improving one behavior can impair another, so task progress can depend on alleviating the conflict. LLM-based AutoResearch systems, which iteratively edit model code and retain edits based on scalar task-performance feedback, have largely ignored this trade-off. We find that scalar feedback supports broad exploration early in search, but it does not reveal how edits affect competing behaviors. In matched-budget experiments, introducing competing-behavior feedback as task gains diminish increases the share of proposals that improve both behaviors and sustains progress beyond scalar-only plateaus. Obtaining this feedback for a given model requires identifying its competing behaviors and designing probes to measure them. To make competing-behavior feedback actionable, we introduce ConflictGuide. Its reusable ConflictGuide-Skill combines a literature-grounded taxonomy with model-specific evidence to identify competing behaviors and specify probes for a code agent to implement as metrics. Evolution proceeds in two stages: Stage I explores with task feedback; Stage II uses probe feedback to steer proposals toward conflict alleviation and retains marginal-gain edits only when probes indicate sufficient alleviation. Across five diverse model families, ConflictGuide reduces task and conflict-related errors by up to 28% and 14%, respectively, relative to scalar-only AutoResearch, with gains extending to other code agents.

</details>


### [290] [Coverage Before Control: Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering for Controllable Retrosynthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39955)
*Xuemin Chen,Xiaozhuang Song,Xinjian Zhao,Yaoyao Xu,Tianshu Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RIGS（Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering），一个面向指令条件单步逆合成反应预测的两阶段框架。Stage A训练语言投影器，将自然语言指令与产物局部候选前体集偏好对齐；Stage B通过轻量级残差适配器将学习到的指令表示转移到冻结的GraphDiT生成器中。核心原则是"先覆盖后控制"（coverage before control），即候选覆盖是实现指令响应式生成的前提。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单步逆合成模型通常以"是否恢复记录反应"来评估，但实际化学家需要在多个合理前体集中根据偏好（如保留特定基序）进行选择。仅恢复记录答案无法衡量模型是否真正具备指令跟随能力。真实场景需要同时具备"候选覆盖"和"指令控制"两个能力，但目前对二者关系缺乏系统研究。

Method: 1) 构造嵌套式一对多训练支持：对每个产物，通过DESP模板库和启发式评分生成Top K（K=15/30/45/60）候选前体集。2) Stage A（生成器无关的语义接地）：冻结Qwen3-Embedding-8B编码指令，冻结反应对编码器编码候选，由KL损失和成对损失训练一个轻量投影器P_φ，将指令映射到反应表示空间。3) Stage B（残差指令引导）：将投影器初始化为Stage A结果，通过节点-文本交叉注意力适配器在选定GraphDiT层注入指令残差，更新公式为 h_{l+1} = B_l(h_l + α·A_{l,θ}(h_l, M_c^{(l)}))。训练目标包含四项：正流匹配损失L_pos、排序损失L_rank、回放参考KL损失L_roll和参考保护KL损失L_guard。4) 推理时重用基础CTMC采样器，按采样频率对去重后的有效前体进行排序。

Result: 在USPTO-MR和合成模板扩展Top15/30/45/60上评估8M和65M GraphDiT：1) 候选覆盖：从USPTO-MR的2,348（8M）和1,723（65M）提升至Top30的16,922和20,075，但Top45到Top60呈非单调变化。2) 指令控制：65M Top30的Matched-Shuffled P@1提升+18.52 pp，N@10降低27.19 pp，效果在Top30/Top45最佳，Top60几乎无提升。3) Stage A接地的作用：在8M Top30测试中，Stage A使N@10的Matched-Shuffled降低6.82 pp，主要抑制与指令冲突的候选。4) 跨数据集和指令套件验证：在Pistachio、Structure（自由形式结构指令）和Metric4（合成相关属性）上均证实了控制能力，65M Top30在Structure上P@1提升+8.09 pp，N@10降低18.44 pp。5) 多步规划案例：将RIGS作为单步生成器集成到价值引导的AND-OR树搜索中，可引导整条合成路线选择无卤前体。

Conclusion: RIGS成功实现了指令条件的单步逆合成生成，将语言指令接地到产物局部候选偏好，并通过残差适配器转移到冻结生成器。系统研究表明"覆盖"与"控制"在两个模型规模下呈一致但非单调的关系：合成支持扩展提高了候选恢复率，但继续扩展至Top60反而使指令控制增益下降甚至为负。Stage A语义接地主要贡献于抑制与指令冲突的候选，而非促进首选候选的恢复。控制与覆盖在跨数据集（Pistachio）、跨指令类型（Structure、Metric4）和多步规划中均得到验证。当前局限在于评估聚焦单步，多步规划尚未系统评估，未来工作将集成到LLM引导的规划中并改进输出有效性。

Abstract: Single-step retrosynthesis models are commonly evaluated by their ability to recover recorded reactions. In practice, chemists may need to choose among several precursor sets for the same product, for example to preserve a particular motif. Recovering a recorded answer alone does not establish this ability to follow a preference. Satisfying such requests requires both coverage of relevant alternatives and control over which alternatives are favored. We introduce Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering (RIGS), a two-stage framework for instruction-conditioned retrosynthesis. Stage A trains a language projector, teaching it which alternatives an instruction favors or discourages. Stage B uses the projector learned in Stage A to steer a frozen generative model through lightweight residual adapters. We construct nested one-to-many training supports by pairing each product with increasing numbers of candidate precursor sets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that broader support helps the model generate a wider range of alternatives, and RIGS can learn to guide generation according to instructions. The relationship between coverage and control is consistent across model scales but non-monotone.

</details>


### [291] [Better Deck or Different Judge? Evaluating Agentic Harness Gains in Corporate and Investment Banking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39958)
*Ludovic Gibert,Matis Despujols,Andre-Louis Rochet*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究对一套用于企业及投资银行（CIB）演示文稿生成的智能体系统进行回顾性评估，比较该系统与无框架直接生成的效果，并量化LLM评分者的可靠性。结果显示，完整系统在17个交付物上一致优于27B模型的直接生成（文本评估提升20.4-33.6分），但与直接Opus生成的差距很小（-4.7至+0.8分）；同时LLM评分者具有显著的随机性，对未改动文档的重复评分也会产生变动，使得小幅改进难以与评分波动区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在CIB演示文稿生成系统的迭代开发中，使用LLM评分者引导提示、模板和代码的修改，并据此判断改进是否有效。但LLM评分本身存在位置、冗长度、自我偏好等偏差，且对长文档的评分可靠性很少以评分点为单位报告。因此需要量化：(1)同一评分者重复评分的不一致性；(2)评估系统相对直接生成的真实提升；(3)评分者间在进展判断与最终排序上的一致性。

Method: 研究对象为基于Qwen3.8-27B模型构建的混合生成框架，包含财务计算引擎、剧本（playbook）、已编译叙述条款与输出验证检查。17个交付物（覆盖范围、信用、融资、并购四类）经过8轮开发迭代。使用rubric引导评分，5-8名来自6个模型家族的评分者（Opus、Sonnet、Haiku、DeepSeek、GLM、GPT-6 Luna Pro、Gemini、Qwen）评估完整系统、27B短/强提示直接生成、Opus短/强提示直接生成。对其中一轮进行了清洗文本的仅文本评分（移除模板标记）。采用ICC、Cohen's κ、Spearman相关、最小可检测变化（MDC₉₅）、Wilcoxon符号秩检验、Bootstrap置信区间、双向方差分解等统计方法分析评分一致性、进展及系统优势。

Result: 主要结果：(1) 评分可靠性有限——同一Opus两次评分在轮次7和8的ICC为0.77-0.78（区间低至0.31-0.44），合并后单文档噪声尺度为7.9-8.4分；(2) 系统优势显著——在清洗文本评分中，所有5位评分者均给完整系统评分高于27B直接生成20.4-33.6分（满分95分），且全部17个交付物均如此；但与Opus直接生成的差距仅为-4.7至+0.8分；(3) 评分者间一致——所有评分者均看到轮次1到轮次7的改进（5.6至13.9分）；但对最终文档排序的一致性低于对汇总分数的一致性（轮次7中位数成对Spearman=0.30）；(4) 评分变动的偏移集中于评分会话，单一会话承担了大部分重复评分变动；(5) 一致性与审计性维度贡献了相对权重最大的内容差距（19%-32%）。

Conclusion: 该研究得出三点主要结论：(1) 完整智能体框架在开发案例上一致优于27B模型的直接生成，但在清洗文本评分中与Opus直接生成几乎持平；(2) 评分者对开发进展的广泛认同一致，但对最终文档的排序认同度较低；(3) 更换评分者或会话可使未变动的文档得分发生变化，因此小幅度改进难以与评分随机性区分。实践建议包括固定评分配置、重复评分以估计变异性、在阈值附近关注连续分数而非二元裁决、以及在涉及呈现差异时增加仅文本评分。

Abstract: Corporate and investment banking teams use presentations to support credit decisions and advise clients on financing and transactions. Producing these decks requires reconciling financial data, tracing sources and turning analysis into a recommendation. We retrospectively study the development of an agentic harness combining a 27B language model, financial calculations, narrative templates and validation checks. LLM judges guide engineering changes and assess the resulting decks, raising the question of whether higher scores reflect better documents or changes in grading. In shared-session text-only grading with template markers removed, five judges score the complete system 20.4 to 33.6 points out of 95 above the same model generating directly from a short prompt. Every judge scores the system higher on all seventeen development deliverables. Margins against direct Opus generation from a short prompt range from -4.7 to +0.8 points. Judges agree on broad progress across development rounds but agree less on final-deck rankings than on pooled scores. Repeated grading also shifts scores on unchanged decks, making small improvements difficult to distinguish from judge variability.

</details>


### [292] [AIMS: An Agentic AI Framework for Sim-to-Real Multi-Modal ISAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39964)
*Yijie Bian,Kai Zhang,Wei Guo,Zixin Wang,Shenghui Song,Jun Zhang,Khaled B. Letaief*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AIMS，一个面向sim-to-real多模态ISAC的智能体AI框架，通过双智能体架构（场景构建智能体+场景理解智能体）将自然语言部署请求转化为部署特定的sim-to-real配置，并在DeepSense 6G真实数据集上验证了车辆检测与波束预测性能的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态ISAC数据驱动模型依赖大量标注真实数据，限制了可扩展部署。虽然合成数据可减轻负担，但将现有仿真流水线适配到目标部署需要协调场景、感知、无线和学习配置，组件间不匹配会损害sim-to-real可迁移性。核心挑战在于如何从高层自然语言部署请求推导出一致的sim-to-real配置，并处理组件间的耦合依赖关系。

Method: 采用基于LLM的双智能体架构：(1) 场景构建智能体——经"地理接地→动态激活→无线投影"三阶段，从共享物理状态生成同步的感知与无线数据；(2) 场景理解智能体——配置任务相关模态与MoE学习，支持零样本推理或少样本适配。结构化领域知识（任务/能力/依赖）指导依赖感知规划，验证证据支持反馈驱动的修订。以Qwen3-14B为LLM骨干，在共享实验状态上进行规划与反思循环。

Result: 在DeepSense 6G数据集上：(1) 波束预测——AIMS零样本模型在Scenario 3和4上均优于5个基线，Top-3较最强融合基线提升约7-16个百分点；20样本少样本适配进一步提升性能；(2) 车辆检测——AIMS在Scenario 3和9上的AP较最强融合基线提升约6-13个百分点；(3) 智能体编排基准（140个请求）——AIMS在正常/挑战层级的Plan-TSR分别为100%和88.6%，显著优于Direct LLM和Tool-only AIMS，结构化领域知识将Dependency-F1从87.0%提升至100%。

Conclusion: AIMS通过智能体AI框架有效解决了sim-to-real多模态ISAC的部署特定配置挑战，结构化领域知识与验证反馈显著提升了规划正确性与依赖处理能力。未来工作可探索性能驱动的闭环优化，将下游感知与通信性能作为反馈进一步指导配置与适配决策。

Abstract: Multi-modal integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables environmental perception and reliable connectivity for intelligent wireless networks. Data-driven multi-modal ISAC models depend heavily on annotated real-world data to learn relationships across sensing and wireless observations, thereby constraining scalable deployment. Although synthetic data generation reduces the burden, adapting existing simulation pipelines to a target deployment requires consistent scene, sensing, wireless, and learning configurations, while mismatches among these coupled components impair sim-to-real transferability. To address the challenge, we propose an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for sim-to-real multi-modal ISAC, named AIMS. Given a natural-language deployment request specifying the target task, deployment conditions, and real-data budget, AIMS derives a deployment-specific sim-to-real configuration and coordinates its execution to produce a deployment-specific task model. A two-agent architecture coordinates scene construction with task learning. A scene construction agent generates geographically grounded, synchronized sensing and wireless records from shared physical states, while a scene understanding agent configures task-relevant modalities and mixture-of-experts (MoE) learning for zero-shot inference or few-shot adaptation. Structured domain knowledge guides dependency-aware planning, while validation evidence supports feedback-driven revision of affected decisions. Experiments on the real-world DeepSense~6G dataset demonstrate improved vehicle detection and beam prediction over the considered simulation and fusion baselines. A separate orchestration benchmark evaluates task interpretation, dependency reasoning, and feedback-driven replanning across diverse deployment requests, showing improved plan correctness with structured domain knowledge and validation feedback.

</details>


### [293] [What Can Component-Replacement Evidence Establish? A Critical Scoping Review of Local Decisions in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39989)
*Shuyang Zhang,Jianshuo Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是一项关于语言模型智能体中"组件替换"评估的系统性范围综述，区分了组件替换的"任务级收益"与"局部决策质量贡献"，指出仅靠在线执行或局部与任务指标的同步改善不足以证明更好的局部决策解释了任务级收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体中替换某个组件会改变后续轨迹、观测和恢复机会，但现有评估常混淆局部决策质量提升与任务级收益，需要厘清两者区别并规范评估报告标准。

Method: 对348项研究进行范围综述（scoping review），审查90条比较记录（来自40项纳入研究），通过8个有目的选取的案例进行跨案例综合分析，围绕替换的决策、执行条件、测量可比性、对照设置和剩余解释展开。

Result: 222项报告局部决策指标的研究中，142项同时报告任务端点指标，49项报告代理指标；三个案例分别因对照局限、离线代理指标、未建立完成优越性而无法充分归因；跨案例分析识别出恢复与中断、干预时机、下游使用三类候选机制。

Conclusion: 综述明确区分了组件替换的任务级收益与局部决策质量的贡献，衍生出8项声明特异性报告条目；在线执行或局部与任务指标的同步改善本身不足以证明更好的局部决策能够解释任务级收益。

Abstract: Background. A component replacement in a language-model agent changes an execution trajectory, potentially altering later observations, resource use, and recovery opportunities. Different evidence is needed to assess its task-level benefit and the contribution of local decision quality. Methods. This critical scoping review maps 348 studies and examines 90 comparison records: 88 from 40 included studies and two from supplementary studies. Eight purposively selected cases structure the synthesis around the replaced decision, executed conditions, measurement comparability, controls, and remaining explanations. Results. Of 222 studies reporting local decision metrics, 142 also report measured task endpoints and 49 report proxies. These counts identify studies that report both types of measurement, without establishing that the measurements come from matched comparisons. Outcome Monitors reports a package-level completion gain whose attribution to detector quality remains limited; First-chunk selection reports a local improvement assessed against an offline proxy endpoint; Evidence-Carrying Termination reports fewer premature unsupported terminations and completion non-inferiority, without establishing completion superiority. Cross-case analysis identifies three candidate mechanisms involving recovery and disruption, intervention timing, and downstream use. Attribution and deployment depend on the comparison controls, label definitions, and information available to the controller. Conclusions. The review distinguishes the task-level benefit of a component replacement from the contribution of local decision quality and derives eight claim-specific reporting items. Neither online execution nor simultaneous gains in local and task metrics alone establish that better local decisions explain the task-level gain.

</details>


### [294] [Who Verifies the Graph? Misspecification Attacks on Causal Action Verification for Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40027)
*Fabio Rovai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对因果动作验证器 CIVeX 进行了红队测试，发现仅通过篡改其所依赖的"可信"动作-状态图（而非代码或证书格式），就能让原本零虚假执行的验证器完全失效。论文提出三种图错误（省略双向边、误把碰撞因子当混杂、颠倒中介变量方向），并提出了一种基于有界随机实验的"证明"防御机制，系统量化了恢复安全性与恢复效用之间的成本不对称性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CIVeX 等因果动作验证器通过检查提议干预相对于提交图的可识别性来把关状态变更工具调用，其证书内含识别论证和单侧置信下界。然而此类验证器的安全性完全依赖于一个它无法检查的输入——提交图（由领域专家提供并存储在注册表中）。图注入、调整集污染和版本漂移是 CIVeX 原始论文承认的开放问题，但从未被量化：失败有多快、失败长什么样、防御成本是多少。本文正是为回答这三个问题。

Method: 方法：保留 CIVeX 的分诊程序、证书检查器和对抗性 Causal-ToolBench 生成器不变，仅改变提交图这一唯一输入。

1. **基准设置**：每个实例是结构因果模型采样的工具工作流，1,050 个动作/单元；动作 T（提议行动）、效用 Y、两个观测协变量、一个对抗性隐混杂 U（强度参数 s 可调）；观测样本 500 行，随机化样本 500 行。

2. **验证器决策逻辑**：在提交图上搜索后门调整集，存在则用 OLS 估计并计算 95% 单侧下界，EXECUTE（≥0）或 REJECT；不存在则走 EXPERIMENT 或 ABSTAIN。

3. **三种攻击**：
   - 省略双向 T↔Y 边（denied 图）：让后门调整集变得不充分
   - 误把碰撞因子 C 提交为混杂因子
   - 颠倒中介变量方向（把 T→M 改成 M→T）

4. **防御**：在观测识别的 EXECUTE 上增加"证明"步骤——用 500 行随机化样本计算均值差及其 95% 区间，与证书区间对比；不相交则宣布图被证伪。两种响应：refuse（放弃）或 fallback（在随机化样本上重新决策）。

5. **拒绝审计**：对 REJECT 也进行相同的证明与 fallback，成本与拒绝数量成正比。

Result: 三种攻击结果：

1. **省略双向边**：在 s=2.5（发布强度）下，虚假执行率从 0% 跃升至 15.3%（种子范围 13.3–17.3%），91% 的执行有害，效用从 +2.27 跌至 +0.35。强度 ≥3.0 时所有执行都有害，效用为负（-1.36 至 -1.85），远低于永弃底线 +0.98。

2. **碰撞因子作混杂**：在无隐混杂的真实图下，正确执行从 52.9% 降至 7.9%，效用从 +2.79 降至 +1.39，但虚假执行仍为零——失败模式为瘫痪而非错误执行。

3. **中介方向颠倒**：完全反转——虚假执行 48.9%，正确执行 0%，效用 -1.36，100% 的有益动作丢失。

**防御效果**：
- 对省略边攻击：证明在 s≥2.0 时检出了所有有害执行；refuse 使虚假执行归零（1,050 动作的 95% 置信上界约 0.29%）。
- 在真实图上：仅 2/555 误报（0.4%），效用损失极小（+2.79→+2.76）。
- 但证明只在观测 EXECUTE 上触发，不能恢复有益动作：在发布强度下，refuse 仍丢失 100% 有益动作，fallback 仍丢失 97.1%。

**关键发现：成本不对称**
- 恢复安全性：127 次实验/1,050 动作
- 恢复效用：还需额外 614 次实验（约 4.8 倍）
- 完全审计所有拒绝 → 精确复现诚实图的决策并花费相同的 741 次实验
- 机制：被错误拒绝的 555 个有益动作中有 539 个在第一次分诊即被拒绝，证明从未检查它们；其证书与 EXECUTE 一样携带完整识别论证、估计和区间。

补充发现：fallback 若复用提交图的调整集，会在方向翻转攻击下重现错误（48.9% 虚假执行）；只有采用"图无关"的均值差策略才能归零。

Conclusion: **核心结论**：因果动作验证器对其无法检查的提交图进行认证——一处省略的边或一个颠倒的箭头即可使所有认证执行全部错误，而证书在内部依然有效。基于有界实验的证明+拒绝/不可测时拒绝的方案，在生成的所有攻击下都达到了零虚假执行，但代价与执行数量成正比，并未恢复被同一错误拒绝的有益动作。这些动作可以通过审计拒绝来恢复，但账单与拒绝数量成正比；完全恢复成本恰好等于诚实图原本的开支。

**面向代理验证研究的三点建议**：
1. 将提交图视为具有独立完整性要求的攻击面；
2. 应同时报告错误行动与错误不作为；
3. 应分别为两者预算审计成本。

**对部署的警示**：仅监测虚假执行的部署会看到一个记录干净的验证器，却在悄悄不作为；错误不作为不会留下可观察的后果，因此必须主动付费去重新审视那些大多本就正确的拒绝决策。

**论文自我边界**：基准是合成的；攻击直接编辑图而非模拟有能力的攻击者；证明假设有界随机化样本存在且廉价（不可逆动作失败）；拒绝审计是均匀采样，未测试针对性策略。

Abstract: Causal action verifiers gate an agent's state-changing tool calls by checking whether each proposed intervention is identifiable against a committed action-state graph, and they issue a certificate that carries the identification argument and a one-sided lower confidence bound. One such verifier, CIVeX, reports zero false executions on a confounded tool-use benchmark. We red-team it by corrupting only the committed graph. Omitting a single bidirected edge takes it from zero false executions to 15.3% at the benchmark's published confounding strength, with 91% of its executions harmful and utility falling from +2.27 to +0.35. Reversing one arrowhead, so that a mediator is committed as a confounder, gives 48.9% false executions and no correct ones. Every one of these actions carries an internally valid certificate. An attestation step that tests each observationally certified execution against a bounded randomised sample detected both attacks, with 2 false alarms in 555 executions on a truthful graph; refusing what fails the test, or cannot be tested, gave zero false executions in every setting we measured. It does not restore beneficial execution: at the published strength 97.1% of beneficial actions are still never executed, because the same misspecification rejects them before attestation runs. Those rejections carry certificates too, and auditing them works, but its cost scales with the number of rejections rather than the number of executions. Recovering safety costs 127 experiments per 1,050 actions; recovering the lost value costs 614 more, at which point the audited verifier makes the honest graph's decisions on every instance and spends exactly its experiment budget. An audit that inspects only executions protects against wrongful action. Wrongful inaction has to be paid for separately.

</details>


### [295] [PTNO: Training Neural Operators with Noisy Monte Carlo Estimates for Particle Transport Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40090)
*Yubo Cao,Xi Deng,Mengqi Xia,Vignesh Gopakumar,Ander Gray,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PTNO（粒子传输神经算子），首次将神经算子直接训练于高方差、未收敛的蒙特卡洛标签，用于学习辐射传输与中子传输的替代模型。核心创新在于：(1) 理论证明无偏MC标签与平方损失下，噪声标签与收敛解共享同一总体最小化解；(2) 提出软plus输出层保留正性与高动态范围表征；(3) 采用点相对L2损失(PRelL2)，以stop-gradient预测作分母避免对噪声标签的非线性变换，从而消除Jensen偏差。在四个数据集(远场辐射、3D通量、球形托卡马克、EU-DEMO反应堆)上验证了方法，相较收敛MC在CPU上提速10^4-10^5倍，匹配精度下MC成本为代理模型的0.8-11倍(辐射传输)或10^3-10^5倍(中子传输)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 粒子传输问题在辐射传输与聚变反应堆设计中至关重要，但高精度蒙特卡洛模拟需追踪海量粒子，成本高昂。现有学习替代模型通常依赖昂贵的已收敛MC标签，且面临两大挑战：(1) 高方差标签使标准监督学习不稳定；(2) 解跨越多个数量级(HDR)，常用对数变换对噪声标签引入Jensen偏差。如何直接从低成本的噪声MC标签学习算子成为核心难题。

Method: 方法包括三个核心设计：(1) 理论证明对无偏估计，平方损失下噪声标签与收敛解的总体最小化解相同(因噪声项均值为零且与模型无关)；(2) 采用软plus输出层B_θ=softplus(G_θ)保证预测正性，无需变换噪声标签；(3) 提出点相对L2损失(PRelL2)，以stop-gradient的预测作分母S(x)=max(sg(x),η)，残差保持在线性物理空间，避免Jensen偏差；同时进行梯度分析，证明该组合仅在B_θ=U处有输出空间不动点。预算分配研究表明，固定粒子预算下，覆盖更多噪声场景优于少数已收敛场景。

Result: 在四个数据集上，PTNO+PRelL2均显著优于基线：远场辐射log10 SSIM达0.917(对比log MSE的0.470)，3D通量达0.952，球形托卡马克达0.863，EU-DERM达0.792。中子传输任务上PTNO比收敛MC在CPU上快10^4-10^5倍，比匹配精度MC便宜10^3-10^5倍；辐射传输任务上MC匹配精度成本为PTNO的0.8-11倍。消融实验表明预测归一化分母(PRelL2)是稳定关键，软plus头提供额外增益；显式Jensen去偏策略无法完全弥合性能差距。

Conclusion: PTNO成功证明可直接从高方差蒙特卡洛标签训练神经算子替代模型，避免昂贵收敛标签的生成。通过理论分析与实证展示了无偏MC标签的有效性、软plus输出层与预测归一化PRelL2损失的稳定性、以及大量噪声场景优于少数收敛场景的预算分配原则。该方法在辐射传输与中子传输领域均实现显著加速(中子传输10^3-10^5倍)，为聚变反应堆设计与多物理场耦合优化提供了实用的代理模型。局限性包括：假设线性物理空间无偏MC估计器、依赖算子容量、分布外泛化未验证。

Abstract: Particle transport under multiple scattering is central to radiative transfer and plasma physics, yet high-fidelity Monte Carlo (MC) simulations must trace prohibitively many particles. Learning-based surrogates can amortize this cost, but typically train on expensive, well-converged MC solutions. We propose the Particle Transport Neural Operator (PTNO), a neural operator that learns particle transport surrogates directly from noisy, low-cost MC labels. Such labels pose two challenges: (1) high variance, which destabilizes standard supervised learning, and (2) a high dynamic range (HDR) spanning many orders of magnitude. For the first, we learn the solution operator from noisy labels of many configurations, amortizing MC cost and generalizing to unseen configurations. Because MC labels are unbiased, we show that the squared loss on them shares its minimizer with the loss on converged solutions, and our budget-allocation study over training scenes $M$, MC samples per render $N$, and independent renders per scene $K$ shows that many noisy scenes beat fewer converged ones. For the second, a nonlinear transform such as the logarithm biases noisy supervision. Instead, PTNO keeps labels in physical space and enforces positivity with a softplus output layer that represents small values effectively. We further train with a pointwise relative $L_2$ loss (PRelL2), the stop-gradient relative loss of HDR denoising and neural rendering, which normalizes each residual by the stop-gradient prediction instead of the noisy label. We demonstrate PTNO on neutron transport in fusion reactors and radiative transfer in participating media. On the two neutronics tasks, PTNO is $10^4$-$10^5\times$ faster than converged MC on the same CPU and $10^3$-$10^5\times$ cheaper than MC at matched accuracy; on the two radiative-transfer tasks, MC at matched accuracy costs $0.8$-$11\times$ as much as PTNO.

</details>


### [296] [Agent Error Dataset: Scaling 50,000 Error--Diagnosis Pairs for Failure Analysis and Error-Aware Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40111)
*Kunlun Zhu,Xuyan Ye,Yibo Li,Cheng Qian,Beibin Li,Heng Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Agent Error Dataset（AED），包含50,228条跨33个环境、19种智能体框架和23个策略模型的错误-诊断对，并设计五阶段AET流水线将失败经验转化为诊断SFT和执行器恢复训练数据。配对回放实验显示首次提议修正将验证通过率从18.4%提升至51.1%（+32.7 pp）；全诊断SFT在1,656个任务上训练后，Qwen3-8B在内部精确步骤一致率上从47.2%提升至63.6%，超越最强提示基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体后训练仅使用结果奖励，未指定应修订哪个决策以及应替换为什么动作。失败回滚中保留了可观察信息，但缺乏将这些失败经验转化为可学习诊断与修正监督的系统方法，亟需跨执行设置的失败诊断数据集与训练范式。

Method: 1) 五阶段AET流水线（Collect→Diagnose→Ground→Replay→Build Views）收集自然失败、生成诊断与提议修正、基于执行证据校验、对照原始动作进行配对回放；2) 构建诊断SFT、执行器恢复SFT和动作偏好三种训练视图；3) 在Qwen3-8B上进行全诊断监督微调，评估精确步骤一致率与公共基准迁移性；4) 比较成功监督、预防性修复、错误后动作监督与反思性修复四种执行器训练方案。

Result: 配对回放3062对中，首次提议将验证通过率从18.4%提升至51.1%（+32.7 pp，95% CI [28.4, 37.0]）；全诊断SFT在1656任务上三种子平均将内部精确步骤一致率从47.2%提升至63.6%，优于最强提示基线Claude Opus 5的54.7%；动作修复训练在WebShop-lite上比仅成功训练高6.67 pp，但在TextQuest上低约9 pp；公共基准迁移效果依赖协议，部分条件下出现显著负迁移。

Conclusion: AED通过结构化记录自然失败、诊断与配对回放证据，证实提议修正显著优于原始动作重试，且诊断监督可显著提升内部故障定位一致率；但公共基准迁移受提示协议影响呈现环境依赖性，执行器修复训练的收益因环境而异。内部定位改进明确，跨基准广泛迁移仍是未解问题。

Abstract: An unsuccessful LLM agent rollout contains more information than its final reward: the observations available to the agent, the actions it chose, and the environment's responses. Reusing this experience for learning requires identifying a decision to revise and testing a concrete alternative. We introduce the Agent Error Dataset (AED), comprising 50,228 error-diagnosis pairs from 9,961 source tasks across 33 environments, 19 harness families, and 23 policy models in text-based agent systems. We retain source traces and execution metadata to support cross-setting failure analysis and re-diagnosis without repeating the original rollout. Our five-stage Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline collects natural failures, generates diagnoses and proposed corrections, and checks them against recorded evidence. Where replay is supported, we compare corrections with original-action retries from the same checkpoint under matched execution settings. We then construct separate training views for diagnosis and actor recovery. Across 3,062 matched replay pairs, first-proposal corrections raise verifier pass rates from 18.4% to 51.1%, a gain of 32.7 percentage points. Using a separately frozen diagnosis release, full-diagnosis fine-tuning on 1,656 source tasks raises Qwen3-8B's exact-step agreement with internal teacher labels from 47.2% to 63.6%, averaged over three seeds on a 943-case holdout. The strongest prompted reference in this comparison scores 54.7%, and mean agreement improves at each of four increasing training-set sizes. In a single-seed comparison of actor-training recipes, action-only repair training scores 6.67 percentage points higher on WebShop-lite than success-only training.

</details>


### [297] [Unlearnable, or Unmeasured? On the Reliability of Difficulty Labels in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40115)
*Chandak Chakma,Syed Nazmus Sakib,Nafiul Haque,Shifat E. Arman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）中所谓的"不可学习"现象。作者发现这些被标记的困难提示确实在学习，只是学习速率约为可学习组的三分之一。同时指出，用于定义"不可学习"提示集的难度标签极不可靠，集合大小会因聚合规则不同从74变化到228；梯度相似度证据也因样本量不匹配而被显著削弱。论文提出了基于二项分布的采样预算框架，可预测难度标签的可重复性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chen等人(2026)报告了RLVR中存在"不可学习"提示（即偶尔产生正确答案但训练中几乎不改进），并将其与组内较低的梯度相似度联系起来。这一结论依赖于通过对有限采样的成功率进行阈值化来识别困难提示。然而，作者质疑：这些标签本身是否可靠？如果集合定义不稳定，那么基于该集合的机制性解释是否仍然成立？该研究旨在从测量可靠性角度重新审视这一现象。

Method: 使用Qwen2.5-0.5B模型在1023条MATH提示上以GRPO训练五个独立种子，沿用原始的"易学/可学/不可学"分组与阈值τ=0.1。主要测量包括：(1) 训练奖励斜率以表征学习速度；(2) 在相同检查点上改变采样响应来分离评估噪声与训练种子变异；(3) 基于二项分布与Kiefer-Wolfowitz非参数MLE估计潜在通过率分布，建立预测Jaccard一致性的采样预算模型；(4) 匹配正确rollout数量后重算组内梯度余弦相似度比值。预先冻结两个未测量预算(N=40, N=64)的预测再生成对应评估进行前瞻验证。

Result: (1) "不可学习"组的奖励斜率为+0.0422/100步（95% CI [+0.0259, +0.0590]），可学习组为+0.1119，易学组为+0.3800——确实更慢，但非零，约为可学习速率的三分之一。(2) 固定292个候选提示，原始五种子构造返回74条，另一种聚合返回228条；N=32时同模型重采样Jaccard=0.798，可重现约81%的跨种子分歧。(3) 采样预算模型预测：8次rollout仅0.63一致性，达0.90需约242次；前瞻冻结的N=40预测[0.770,0.853]与实测0.845一致，N=64预测[0.798,0.879]与实测0.874一致。(4) 匹配样本量后，易学/不可学梯度相似度比从2.327倍降至1.539倍（CI [1.26, 1.88]），削弱但未消除。(5) 简单"曝光饥饿"假设不成立：D_u组平均仍有2.14次贡献步骤，22.4%的提示接收了不低于可学组的曝光仍改进缓慢。

Conclusion: RLVR中的"不可学习"现象经重新分析应理解为持续的缓慢学习效应，而非字面意义上的无法学习。但用于定义该效应的提示集合高度依赖聚合规则与采样预算，远比效应本身不稳定；解释该效应的梯度相似度证据在匹配样本量后被大幅削弱但未消除。当前低预算的难度标签不足以支撑将个别提示归类为"不可学习"或建立机制性主张；应将难度分配视为一个明确的采样预算问题，通过预测的Jaccard一致性来选择预算，而非依赖启发式的多种子聚合。论文的核心贡献不在于否定该现象，而在于指出测量选择对结论的关键影响。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach for improving reasoning during post-training. Recent work suggests that some difficult prompts remain resistant to learning even when they occasionally produce correct solutions. We revisit this unlearnability phenomenon and find that the affected prompts do improve, at roughly one third of the learnable rate, while the difficulty-defined set used to study them is much less reproducible than expected. These difficulty labels are estimated from a limited number of sampled responses. Combining them across seeds can further change which prompts are selected instead of simply reducing measurement noise. We develop a sampling-based framework for quantifying this instability and determining how much evaluation is required for difficulty assignments to reproduce reliably. We also revisit the gradient-similarity evidence proposed to explain unlearnability and show that part of the observed separation arises because difficult prompts provide fewer correct rollouts from which their gradients can be estimated. Matching this sample count weakens the gradient difference but does not remove it. Overall, the slow-learning phenomenon survives our reanalysis, while both the prompts used to define it and the evidence used to explain it require more careful measurement.

</details>


### [298] [Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40169)
*Jingbo Yang,Kwei-Herng Lai,Xiaowen Wang,Yaar Harari,Evgeniy Gabrilovich,Shiyu Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 ScholarEvolve 框架，通过自动从最新研究文献中提取机制来驱动智能体执行框架（agent harness）的演化，在固定基础模型的情况下显著提升任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于元编码智能体修改执行框架的方法受限于智能体自身知识和已观察到的失败，存在探索范围窄、设计知识有限、适应滞后三大问题。作者借鉴人类研究者通过阅读文献寻找新方案的思路，让框架主动从学术文献中获取改进方向。

Method: 将智能体执行框架分解为五个功能模块（工具接口、上下文管理、技能、记忆、智能体工作流），通过失败审计、能力抽象生成检索查询，从 arXiv 检索论文并构建研究池；使用基于 TopicGPT 的主题建模将论文按机制正交分组；以轮询方式分配候选预算，实现研究引导的模块突变；采用类遗传算法进行模块交叉和选择，使用配对自助置信区间保留冠军；通过周期性文献更新实现终身演化。

Result: 在 AppWorld 和 τ²-Bench 上显著优于初始框架和 Meta Harness 基线：Qwen3.5-27B 在 AppWorld Challenge 上 TGC 从 49.6% 提升至 63.6%（+14.0），GPT-5.4-mini 在 τ²-Bench Telecom 上 pass@1 从 72.7% 提升至 81.9%（+9.2）；终身演化三轮文献更新后持续改进（TGC 达 81.55%）；消融实验证实主题引导、模块化突变和研究引导三个组件均贡献正向收益；模块组合效果优于单一最强组件（如 Qwen 组合比最强单独模块 TGC 高 3.5 点）。

Conclusion: ScholarEvolve 通过从研究文献中主动学习机制，结合模块化分解与遗传式搜索，实现了智能体执行框架的终身主动演化，为固定骨干模型的能力提升提供了有效路径，并可泛化到训练时未见的应用场景。

Abstract: Language agents are expected to solve increasingly complex tasks, creating a growing need for continual improvement. One promising approach is to evolve the agent harness, the software that governs tool use, memory management, and task execution, while keeping the underlying language model fixed. Recent methods automate this process by using a meta coding agent to modify the harness based on execution feedback. However, relying on that agent's existing knowledge and observed failures can restrict exploration and make adaptation reactive. Inspired by how human experts learn from the research literature for new solutions, we introduce ScholarEvolve, a framework that automatically draws on state-of-the-art research to guide harness evolution. ScholarEvolve organizes the harness evolution directions into functional modules and uses topic modeling to identify distinct improvement strategies for each module. It implements these strategies and evaluates their combinations to improve task performance. Moreover, the framework is designed to incorporate new publications over time, allowing research advances to drive proactive lifelong evolution. Experiments demonstrate improvements on AppWorld and Tau2-Bench. ScholarEvolve raises Qwen3.5-27B task goal completion from 49.6% to 63.6% on AppWorld Challenge, and raises GPT-5.4-mini pass@1 from 72.7% to 81.9% on Tau2-Bench Telecom.

</details>


### [299] [Belief-Aware Multi-Agent Path Finding under Map Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40269)
*Viraj Parimi,Shao-Hung Chan,Han Zhang,Jingkai Chen,Brian Williams*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Belief-Aware MAPF 问题及 MAGIC 框架，通过高斯马尔可夫随机场与高斯置信传播将观测信息扩展到未观测位置，构造绕行感知代价，在标准 MAPF 基准上对多达 800 个智能体降低 96.3% 实例的执行代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 MAPF 假设环境地图完全已知，但现实中存在障碍物局部扰动；现有方法仅利用直接观测，无法利用空间相关性从一次观测推断邻近未观测位置的可通行性，导致代价高昂的重新规划。

Method: 使用 GMRF 建模不确定位置的潜在分数空间相关性，通过 GaBP 在线更新共享信念；将位置可通行信念与边绕行距离结合，构造绕行感知代价 c_t(e)=b̂·1+(1-b̂)·C_det，并嵌入标准 MAPF 规划器（CBS/EECBS/PBS/PIBT/PIBT+/LaCAM）的规划-执行循环中。

Result: 在 MAPF 基准地图（empty/random/maze/room/warehouse/game/city）上，n=10~800，ϕ=0.20、ρ=0.30、R=3 的标准设置下，MAGIC 在 15 种规划器配置中均优于乐观重规划，96.3% 实例的 SoC 更低；ϕ=0.30 时 MAGIC 仅高于最优全知 SoC 3.6%（乐观重规划 9.4%、MAPF-IM 14.9%）；先验与生成概率对齐时再降 3.4%。

Conclusion: MAGIC 证明了利用空间相关性将局部观测扩展到未观测区域、构造绕行感知代价可显著降低 MAPF 在不确定地图下的执行代价，框架与规划器无关且可扩展至 800 智能体；未来将扩展到终身任务和执行中可通行性变化的场景。

Abstract: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) aims to find collision-free paths for multiple agents in a shared environment. Classical MAPF assumes that all static obstacles are known in advance, but real-world environments can change unexpectedly due to fallen objects, spills, or other local disturbances. When such changes are spatially correlated, an observation can inform traversability estimates beyond the observed location. Prior approaches address uncertainty in traversability through contingent plans or replanning based on direct observations, but do not leverage this spatial dependence to infer the traversability of nearby unobserved locations. As a result, they cannot use one observation to anticipate nearby unobserved obstacles that may cause costly rerouting later. We focus on Belief-Aware MAPF, where map discrepancies are fixed during execution but initially unknown, and observations can be informative beyond the observed location. We propose Multi-Agent Gaussian belief Inference for Coordination (MAGIC), a framework that updates a shared belief about traversability online based on agents' observations. MAGIC uses a Gaussian Markov Random Field and Gaussian Belief Propagation to approximately infer traversability and construct detour-aware costs for standard MAPF planners. Our experiments on MAPF benchmarks show that MAGIC reduces the executed sum of costs compared to existing approaches on 96.3% of instances, across several planner families and teams of up to 800 agents, demonstrating its applicability to large-scale MAPF problems.

</details>


### [300] [PivotOPD: Learning to Recover from Pivotal Mistakes in Multi-Turn Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40285)
*Yinghui He,Yapei Chang,Khushi Bhardwaj,Daniele Molinari,Tugrul Konuk,Jan Kautz,Ali Hatamizadeh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PivotOPD框架，通过教师模型检测多轮智能体中的"关键错误"（pivotal mistake），并在关键回合及其后续恢复回合上对学生模型进行预防性与恢复性蒸馏，从而提升多轮语言智能体的任务完成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在多轮交互中存在错误累积问题：一个错误动作会改变后续状态，导致学生模型偏离教师。作者发现超过一半的失败轨迹包含一个"关键错误"（早期发生的、显著拉远任务完成的错误），且这类错误通常仍可恢复，但现有方法未能有效学习恢复策略。

Method: PivotOPD框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 关键回合检测——教师模型读取失败轨迹，选择候选回合并给出"黄金动作"；(2) 预防性蒸馏——在关键回合使用反向KL损失，靠近黄金动作；(3) 恢复性蒸馏——在关键回合之后的K个恢复回合中，使用前向KL损失，让学生从自身错误产生的状态中学习恢复行为。该方法通过特权自教师（被提示黄金动作的冻结学生）生成密集的token级监督信号，并与基于组的强化学习结合在单一PPO更新中。

Result: PivotOPD在ALFWorld、WebShop和搜索式QA三个基准测试中对13种基线方法均取得最佳平均性能。Qwen3-1.7B学生在ALFWorld上比最强基线提升5.5%，在搜索式QA上提升5.9%。Qwen3-8B学生的恢复率达到72.7%，约为基线模型的9倍。在SWE-Bench Verified上，使用Nemotron-3.5学生模型将解决率提升3.2%（标准OPD仅提升0.2%）。自蒸馏设置下无需更强教师也能保持优势。

Conclusion: PivotOPD通过在关键回合及其后续状态上集中密集教师监督，有效解决了多轮智能体中的错误累积问题。理论分析表明，恢复性蒸馏在学生极少采样的恢复动作上提供了稳定的学习信号，其更新大小依赖于教师分布而非学生分布。实验验证了预防性与恢复性蒸馏的互补性，以及PivotOPD在不同模型族和软件工程领域的迁移能力。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach for training language agents, providing dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, in multi-turn interaction, an incorrect action changes the states the student encounters later, so errors compound across turns. In preliminary experiments across three Qwen3 models (8B to 235B), we find that more than half of the failed rollouts contain a pivotal mistake, an action that moves the agent farther from completing the task, and this mistake typically occurs early. These pivotal mistakes often remain recoverable: guiding the model for only a few turns after the pivotal turn can restore task success. We therefore propose PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation framework that jointly trains the student to prevent pivotal mistakes and to recover from the states they create. At each pivotal mistake, a teacher model provides a gold action and then names a recovery action at each of the next few turns. Preventive distillation uses the gold action with reverse KL to steer the student away from the pivotal mistake, while recovery distillation uses the recovery actions with forward KL to transfer recovery behaviors that the student rarely samples. Against 13 baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA, PivotOPD achieves the strongest average performance for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-8B students, improving over the strongest baseline on ALFWorld by +5.5% with the 1.7B student. The gains also transfer to another model family on the software engineering domain, where PivotOPD raises the resolve rate of a Nemotron-3.5 student on SWE-Bench Verified by +3.2%. Project page: this https URL

</details>


### [301] [How Much of a Harness Does a Strong Agent Need for Autonomous ML Engineering?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40303)
*Kirill Brilliantov,Alejandro Hernández-Cano,Emmanuel Abbé*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文通过大规模系统消融实验证明，在自主机器学习工程（MLE）任务中，给LLM提供编码代理环境（coding agent environment）是最大的性能增益来源，而在此之上精心设计的多代理编排、树搜索等"harness"机制几乎不带来显著收益。论文提出的极简基线Malena（单一长会话编码代理）在固定预算和backbone条件下，在MLE-bench和NatureBench上匹配或超过了四个开源SOTA MLE harness。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前自主MLE agent系统日益复杂化（多代理编排、专用检索子代理等），但这些精心设计的harness在强LLM backbone上的实际价值存疑。此前在SWE-bench等领域已有证据表明多agent工作流并不优于单agent，但MLE领域缺乏严格控制变量的大规模系统验证。论文试图回答：在相同backbone和预算下，harness的哪些组件真正重要？

Method: 采用受控消融研究方法：固定backbone（GLM 5.2等）、硬件（1×A100 80GB）和时间预算（24h），逐步添加harness干预措施。具体消融四类干预：(1) 编码代理环境（Chat→Oneshot）；(2) 搜索策略（Chain/Greedy/UCB1/Best-of-N）；(3) 自主性（Malena单长会话）；(4) 多代理编排（Delegation/Parallelism/Broadcast）。与四个开源SOTA harness（MLEvolve、AiScientist、Arbor、ScienceFlow）在MLE-bench（30任务）和NatureBench（40任务）上进行匹配对比，并通过checkpoint标注和trace分析研究agent的搜索行为。

Result: 关键发现：(1) 编码代理环境是最大单一增益因素，前沿LLM从Chat到Oneshot性能大幅提升；(2) 搜索策略间无统计显著差异（最佳配对UCB1 vs Best-of-N差值95%CI包含0）；(3) Malena单会话基线在所有前沿backbone上匹配或超过四个外部harness（GLM 5.2下Malena获奖率62.5% vs 最佳外部harness 47.1%）；(4) 多代理编排（Delegation/Parallelism）无显著改善；(5) Trace分析显示Malena自适应地平衡稀有技术与性能优化，无需显式harness结构。

Conclusion: 论文得出"苦涩教训"式结论：对于具有强编码代理能力的LLM，精心设计harness的投入回报率低。性能的主要驱动因素是backbone本身的代理能力和运行时环境，而非harness scaffolding。模型的后训练（特别是编码代理环境中的训练）正在替代harness原本要提供的功能——搜索、调试、恢复等。这意味着MLE领域的研发重心应放在模型和后训练上，而非harness设计上。

Abstract: Recent autonomous machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made significant progress on public leaderboards. Often motivated by progress stagnation over long-horizon cycles and limited Large Language Model (LLM) primitives, modern MLE agents are deployed on top of increasingly elaborate machinery: multi-agent orchestrators, dedicated retrieval subagents, and more. While such harnesses expand, the use of more primitive but improved coding agents - where LLMs have direct access to the execution environment through read, write, and bash primitives - has received little attention in the field. In this paper we find that, under an equal time budget and the same frontier LLM backbone, open-source state-of-the-art harnesses provide no advantages over a single session of a minimal-harness coding agent baseline, pointing to the backbone as the primary driver for performance. Via a series of large-scale systematic ablation studies, we argue that the machinery layers become redundant in the coding agent setting. We conclude that the effort spent elaborating hand-crafted harnesses around strong models yields poor returns for current MLE benchmarks.

</details>


### [302] [Cogentic: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Automated Proof Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40324)
*Yang Cai,Vineet Gupta,Yanchen Jiang,Christopher Liaw,Aranyak Mehta,Grigoris Velegkas,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了 Cogentic——一个用于开放式研究问题自动证明发现的多智能体编排系统。该系统通过迭代的"证明-验证"循环，调度独立的证明器探索不同方向，并由专门组件进行对抗性验证，将确认的中间结果存入持久化验证账本以供后续轮次使用。系统使用 Gemini 作为基础模型，在在线学习、拍卖理论和机制设计三个领域的五个开放问题上取得了新结果，均由领域专家独立验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿语言模型虽然能一次性生成优秀的数学想法，但单次生成不足以解决开放式研究问题，因为这类问题需要：探索多个相互竞争的猜想、克服微妙的技术障碍，并在长时程上保留中间进展。现有方法（如交互式定理证明器、程序搜索、推理预算扩展）各有局限：形式化方法缺乏自然语言可读性，程序搜索需要廉价可计算的评分函数，而简单的多采样或多智能体辩论缺乏系统性的验证与进展管理机制。

Method: Cogentic 采用多轮迭代的"证明-验证"循环架构，核心组件包括：(1) 编排器：中央控制器，分配证明器资源，管理全局状态和验证账本；(2) 文献综述员：检索相关定义和定理；(3) 证明器：基于简报独立并行生成候选证明；(4) 验证器：从不同角度对抗性审查证明（先假设错误直至被证伪）；(5) 记录与验证账本：记录尝试历史和已验证的中间引理；(6) 流程顾问：跨轮次调整指令和资源配置；(7) 整合阶段：格式化和审计最终稿件。每轮中，编排器规划方向，顾问为每个证明器定制简报，证明器并行起草，验证器单独和对比审查，通过双重验证的草稿才被接受。验证的中间引理被提取为独立引理重新验证后存入账本供后续使用。系统仅需问题陈述，无需专家提示，端到端自主工作。

Result: Cogentic 以 Gemini 为基础模型，在五个开放问题上取得新结果（均由领域专家独立验证）：(1) 高效在线逆线性优化：首次给出既高效（O(d²) 每轮）又 proper 的 O(d) 遗憾界，与最优 Ω(√d) 仅差 √d 因子；(2) 双边市场竞争复杂度：将常数从至少 20,000 降至 2，且只需在单边（卖方）招募，证明 STR(m,n+2) ≥ OPT(m,n)，且 +1 不够；(3) n 专家随时算法：证明随时遗憾与固定时界遗憾的领先常数在 n→∞ 时一致，消除 √2 因子差距；(4) 简单与最优机制比较：单加性买家情形下，将 5.2 因子改进至 3.52；(5) 自动竞价拍卖的无政府代价：两竞标者时 pFPA₁ 达到 PoA ≤ 1.5（紧界），n 竞标者时 pFPA_{2n} 达到 PoA ≤ 2 - 1/(4n+1)，匹配已知下界至常数因子。推理预算约为 O(100) 至 O(1000) 次 Gemini 调用。

Conclusion: Cogentic 证明了多智能体编排框架能够以相对适中的推理预算（O(100)-O(1000) 次模型调用）自主发现研究级别的数学和理论计算机科学新结果。其核心优势在于方向分配、对抗性验证、跨轮次经验持久化（验证账本）和流程级自适应调整的结合。然而，系统存在局限性：产生候选证明的速度可能超过人工审阅速度，且自然语言证明虽可由专家验证但缺乏形式化保证。未来需解决生成吞吐量与人类理解之间的平衡问题，例如与 Lean 等证明助手结合以实现机器检查的正确性保障。

Abstract: We present Cogentic, a multi-agent harness for automated proof discovery on open research problems. While frontier language models can generate strong mathematical ideas in a single shot, single-shot generation is often insufficient for open problems that require exploring multiple competing conjectures, overcoming subtle technical obstructions, and retaining intermediate progress over a long horizon. Cogentic addresses these challenges through an iterative prove--verify loop in which an orchestrator allocates a population of independent provers across distinct proof directions, subjects their output to adversarial verification by several specialized components, and promotes confirmed intermediate results into a persistent verified ledger that later rounds build on. The harness is designed to be able to solve research-level math and theoretical computer science problems. Using Gemini as the base model, Cogentic produced novel results on five open problems across online learning, auction theory, and mechanism design. Each result was independently verified by domain experts and is developed in full in companion papers. We list these results, and new ones as they are verified, at this https URL .

</details>


### [303] [WorldAuditBench: Interactive 3D World Auditing with Multimodal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40325)
*Ziyan Jiang,Jingbo Yang,Jiabao Ji,Yujian Liu,Qiucheng Wu,Tommi Jaakkola,Yang Zhang,Shiyu Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WorldAuditBench是一个用于评估多模态智能体在交互式3D世界中识别异常能力的基准测试，包含213个异常任务，跨13个环境。实验表明当前最先进的多模态智能体（VLM/VLA）在该任务上的表现远低于人类水平（6.6%-42.3% vs 83.4%），揭示了智能体在主动证据收集与视觉推理耦合方面的重大局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式3D世界被广泛用于研究智能行为，但这些环境中常存在物理、空间、时间和语义层面的异常（如漂浮物体、可穿越墙壁、场景不一致对象等）。现有基准测试要么仅评估静态视觉理解，要么仅关注简单的异常搜索，无法系统评估智能体在交互式3D环境中耦合"行动"与"视觉推理"来发现并验证复杂异常的能力。核心科学问题是：多模态智能体能否自主执行"世界审计"任务，即通过主动探索和推理来识别需要交互或多视角观察才能发现的异常？

Method: 1. **基准数据集构建**：在Unreal Engine 5和Three.js上构建13个交互式3D环境（覆盖室内、城市、历史、工业、自然五大场景类型），共213个手工艺异常任务，按五大类异常族组织（静态物理、交互式物理、空间一致性、时间一致性、语义一致性），共15个细分类别，每个任务经过至少两名独立评审验证。

2. **两种审计范式**：① **VLM-only范式**：单一视觉语言模型VLM接收初始输入（含审计指令、场景描述、异常类型提示、匹配上下文示例和初始RGB观测），通过40步动作预算进行探索，使用环境动作（移动/转向/观察/交互/等待）、记忆工具（回看帧/历史/笔记）和异常报告工具进行自主审计；② **VLA-VLM两阶段范式**：先用Open-P2P 1.2B VLA模型收集60秒固定轨迹（约120帧），再用VLM离线分析轨迹。

3. **评估协议**：评估GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.8 Flash、Muse Spark 1.3、Qwen 3.8 Flash五种模型，使用VLM-as-a-judge（GPT-6 Astra）判定成功与否，并对比10名CS博士生的83.4%人类表现。

4. **消融实验**：系统研究起始距离、探索预算、任务指导（上下文示例与异常类型提示）、多异常共存等因素的影响，并分析异常暴露率（几何覆盖和人类评分）与识别准确率的分离效应。

Result: **主要结果**：
- VLM智能体成功率范围28.2%-42.3%（GPT-6 Astra最佳42.3%，Gemini 3.8 Flash 32.4%，Claude Opus 5 28.2%）
- VLA-VLM两阶段智能体成功率仅6.6%-17.4%
- 所有模型均远低于人类水平83.4%
- 时间一致性异常最难（SR ≤12.5%），静态物理与语义一致性相对容易
- VLM-only范式比VLA-VLM范式快但成本高2.7-10.3倍

**关键发现**：
- 异常暴露率差异显著：VLM智能体几何覆盖91.1% vs VLA探索器47.4%；人类评分暴露68.1% vs 34.7%
- 记忆工具显著提升VLM智能体表现
- 异常类型提示比上下文示例更重要（移除提示导致VLM性能下降17.5个百分点）
- 多异常共存时，完全发现率极低（双异常仅7.1%，三异常仅4.8%）
- VLM优势不仅来自覆盖率，更来自记忆工具与交互能力
- VLA模型在大型3D世界中难以到达目标位置，限制后续分析证据

Conclusion: WorldAuditBench提供了一个系统性的测试平台，用于研究多模态智能体如何在交互式3D环境中耦合行动与视觉推理。研究揭示了当前VLM/VLA智能体在证据收集与跨视角/时间推理方面的重大能力差距：最优AI智能体（42.3%）与人类水平（83.4%）之间存在41个百分点的巨大鸿沟，特别是在时间一致性异常（异常消失/属性变化等需要前后对比的任务）上。未来瓶颈将强化VLM智能体，其推理引导探索的能力显著优于VLA-VLM分离范式。该基准为研究能够形成假设、通过行动验证假设、并跨多视角/时间连接证据的智能体提供了重要测试基础，对具身AI、自动化游戏/3D内容质量保证、模拟环境可靠性验证等领域具有重要价值。

Abstract: As interactive 3D worlds are increasingly used to study intelligent behavior, it becomes important to develop efficient pipelines for identifying anomalies in these simulated environments, such as floating objects, traversable walls, or objects inconsistent with the surrounding scene. Multimodal AI systems, including vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs), have shown potential for automating this task. However, 3D world auditing is complex, requiring the close coupling of two distinct capabilities: action, to navigate the 3D world and search for anomalies systematically and efficiently; and visual reasoning, to understand the environment and identify anomalies from multimodal observations. It remains largely unexplored whether multimodal agents can effectively couple these two capabilities, using visual reasoning to identify potential anomalies while taking actions to validate them. In this paper, we introduce WorldAuditBench, a benchmark for 3D world auditing comprising 213 anomaly tasks across 13 environments built with Unreal Engine 5 and this http URL , spanning five anomaly families. We evaluate five frontier models under a fixed exploration budget using two auditing paradigms: VLA-based exploration followed by VLM-based anomaly identification, and an end-to-end VLM agent in which visual reasoning directly guides action selection. Across the evaluated models and two paradigms, success rates range from 6.6% to 42.3%, substantially below human performance (83.4%). Through the task of world auditing, WorldAuditBench provides a testbed for studying how multimodal agents couple action and visual reasoning in interactive 3D environments, while highlighting current limitations in their ability to gather and interpret evidence during exploration.

</details>


### [304] [Turbo Harness: Instance-Adaptive Harness Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.40330)
*Tunyu Zhang,Hao Wang,Kai Xu,Dimitris N. Metaxas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Turbo Harness提出了一种实例自适应（instance-adaptive）的harness优化框架，通过复用全局harness搜索过程中产生的"副产品"（执行轨迹、反思、评估等），将其蒸馏为结构化的playbook，并训练一个轻量级的harness editor（基于GRPO强化学习），在推理时为每个任务实例生成针对全局harness的定制化补丁（patch），从而在七个涵盖交互式agent、软甲工程和长horizon终端任务的基准测试上一致超越现有的harness优化基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有harness优化方法（如Meta-Harness、Harness-R1等）通常只能产出单一的全局harness，并将其统一应用于所有任务实例。然而，不同任务实例可能受益于不同的harness配置（例如SWE-Bench中不同GitHub仓库的开发流程和测试规范各异），单一全局harness难以同时适配所有场景。此外，harness优化过程中产生的丰富历史信息（候选harness、执行轨迹、成功/失败证据）在优化完成后大多被丢弃，造成信息浪费。

Method: Turbo Harness包含两个核心组件：(1) Playbook构建：从已完成的全局harness搜索档案中，通过提取（extraction）、反思（reflection）和策展（curation）三个离线阶段，将成功和失败的harness编辑策略蒸馏为结构化的playbook，记录策略的适用条件和正反证据；(2) Harness Editor训练：使用Qwen3.5-9B作为轻量级editor模型，以GRPO强化学习进行全参数微调，以任务性能作为奖励信号，学习如何根据任务实例和playbook对全局harness H*生成实例特定的补丁p_x，得到H_x = H* ⊕ p_x。推理时editor仅被调用一次，由冻结的执行模型M在适配后的harness下运行。

Result: 在7个基准测试（ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、DBBench、WebShop、SWE-smith-MR、SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench-2.1）上，Turbo Harness一致优于Meta-Harness及其他基线：在SWE-smith-MR上，Claude Haiku 4.5的通过率从50.7%提升至64.0%，Gemini 3.7 Flash从70.7%提升至88.0%；在Terminal-Bench-2.1上以55.5%的通过率超越Meta-Harness（50.5%）和最佳人工设计harness Terminus-Kira（52.3%），同时降低了执行成本（如SWE-smith-MR上Gemini的执行成本降低约6.7倍）。消融实验表明，RL训练与playbook条件化是互补的，单独使用均不足以超越Meta-Harness。

Conclusion: Turbo Harness通过复用harness优化过程中产生的中间产物（而非将其视为一次性副产品），实现了实例级别的harness自适应，在提升任务性能的同时往往降低执行成本。该方法轻量（editor仅9B参数且每个实例只调用一次），但其有效性依赖于全局搜索的质量和多样性，且editor训练需要额外的环境rollout。未来工作可探索更样本高效的优化方法、editor和playbook在不同任务/域间的迁移，以及进一步挖掘harness优化副产物的可重用经验价值。

Abstract: Automating the search for effective harnesses is an important step toward enabling agents to recursively self-improve. Existing harness optimizations typically produce a single global harness that is applied uniformly across task instances. However, a harness that works well on average may not be optimal for every instance. We introduce Turbo Harness, a framework that can adapt a globally optimized harness to each instance by reusing information generated during the original optimization process. Specifically, Turbo Harness recycles artifacts produced during a completed global harness optimization run, and summarizes them into a structured playbook. We train a harness editor to leverage this prior optimization experience to generate instance-specific patches to the global harness. At inference time, the editor uses the instance and the playbook to construct a tailored harness in which the execution model operates. Through numerical experiments, we show that Turbo Harness consistently outperforms existing harness optimization baselines across seven benchmarks spanning interactive agent tasks, software engineering, and long-horizon terminal tasks.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [305] [How Should Diffusion Language Models Edit Code?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38257)
*Xijia Tao,Ziru Liu,Shansan Gong,Jiacheng Ye,Kecheng Chen,Zirui Wu,Lin Zheng,Xinyu Fu,Rui Liu,Lingpeng Kong*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了掩码扩散语言模型(MDLM)在代码编辑任务中的四种编辑接口(全文重写、搜索替换、定位填充、寻位填充、token级编辑),发现MDLM具备已知位置的多区域协同填充能力,但当编辑位置需自行预测时能力大幅下降,即"组合鸿沟"。通过受控脚手架干预实验,作者将成功的编辑拆解为两个独立要求:覆盖所有必需修改区域与精确界定边界,二者缺一不可。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 指令式代码编辑需要模型决定"在哪里改"(位置)与"改什么"(内容),同时保持其他代码不变。掩码扩散模型的双向去噪能力在理论上天然适合多区域填充,但如何设计编辑接口以让模型有效利用这一能力尚不清楚。本文旨在探究不同编辑接口如何分配"结构决策"与"内容生成"职责,以及为何已知位置的填充能力不能直接转化为可靠的自主编辑。

Method: 1. 定义并实现四种扩散代码编辑接口(全文重写、搜索替换、定位-后填充、token级编辑);2. 在CanItEdit基准上以DiffuCoder-Instruct为基座进行微调;3. 采用"oracle定位"控制(提供金色编辑位置)评估已知位置条件下的填充能力上限;4. 设计"匹配脚手架扰动"实验:固定填充器不变,仅改变脚手架几何形状(丢区域、扩边界、加假阳性孔),分离覆盖与边界精度两个独立变量;5. 在FineEdit Wiki上做句子级定向编辑探针,验证"已知位置vs预测位置"差距是否泛化至非代码领域。

Result: 在142个多跨度编辑实例上:金色位置+旧代码可见的填充达到25.4% pass@1,而直接搜索替换仅11.3%,预测位置混合方法仅10.6%,证实组合鸿沟存在。覆盖实验:丢失一个必需跨度降至6.3%,扩大每个边界±1行降至7.7%,加一个紧假阳性孔仍保持20.4%。Wiki探针显示0.927(金色)vs 0.376(预测)的编辑F1差距。结论:定位是主要瓶颈,边界精度同样关键,仅靠填充能力不足以实现可靠编辑。

Conclusion: 扩散代码编辑的核心不在于填充能力本身,而在于编辑接口如何划分结构分配、内容生成与源码保留。成功的编辑需同时满足两个独立要求:(1)覆盖所有必需修改;(2)精确界定边界避免过度重构正确代码。强填充能力不能保证可靠编辑——接口必须既能暴露所有必需修改,又能限制未修改代码的再生。这些控制原则为评估未来扩散编辑器提供了诊断框架。

Abstract: Code editing requires a model to decide where to make changes, generate the new content, and preserve everything else. We study how masked diffusion language models divide these responsibilities across four editing interfaces: whole-file rewriting, search-and-replace, locate-then-infill, and token-level editing. Experiments on CanItEdit reveal a composition gap: diffusion models can generate coordinated changes when the correct edit locations are supplied, but much of this capability is lost when those locations must be predicted. Access to the intact original code helps the model fill multiple edit regions, yet does not resolve the difficulty of selecting those regions. By varying the editable regions while holding the generation model and decoding procedure fixed, we identify two distinct requirements for successful editing: covering every required change and placing precise boundaries around it. Missing a required region prevents the corresponding change, while widening regions to ensure coverage can sharply reduce success by requiring unchanged code to be regenerated. A sentence-level Wiki editing probe shows the same qualitative gap between supplied and predicted locations beyond code. These findings show why strong infilling capability alone does not ensure reliable editing: the interface must expose all required changes while limiting regeneration of unchanged code.

</details>


### [306] [Zero2Repo: Can Coding Agents Build Repositories from Scratch?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38269)
*Pei Yang,Tianyu Shi,Yuhang Yao,Wanyi Chen,Tongyun Yang,Dun Pei,Haonan Wang,Pengbin Feng,Guanxu Yu,Jingchun Huang,Zeyu Zhang,Shuhan Sun,Hao Li,Xiang Li,Jie Xiao,Xinyu Wang,Hanxin Chen,Daqi Li,Qi Jia,Hongshan Lin,Zhizhou Gu,Zijun Tian,Weizhi Du,Lynn Ai,Eric Yang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Zero2Repo 是一个面向"从零构建完整代码仓库"任务的语言无关基准测试。它通过自动化流水线将真实开源项目转化为行为规范、可复现环境和隐藏验收测试，并采用二元评分（全部通过才算成功）。在11个广为人知的项目上评估三个前沿模型配置，最强模型仅能解决10/11任务，且失败提交通常能通过90-99%的隐藏测试，主要问题集中在规范中未实现的尾部规则或单点遗漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码代理评测存在两大局限：(1) HumanEval、MBPP 等基准仅评估短程序生成；(2) SWE-bench 等基准要求在已有成熟仓库上打补丁，架构、依赖和构建系统已存在。Commit0、NL2Repo-Bench、DevBench、RepoGenesis、RepoZero 等近期工作开始关注从零构建，但仍存在语言受限、依赖人工编写任务、或暴露验收测试等问题。本文旨在回答：代理能否在项目的原生生态系统中交付完整仓库，包括其自身的打包和构建产物，且在工作中不接触验收测试。

Method: （1）任务形式化：每个任务是三元组（公开规范 S、执行环境 E、隐藏验收套件 T）。代理收到 PRD（产品需求文档，按特征点组织行为需求）、接口契约（固定 API/CLI 表面）和空工作区，必须在 wall-clock 预算内交付仓库。二元奖励 R(W)=[W 在 E 下通过 T 的所有测试]。（2）数据集构建：从版本钉定的真实开源仓库出发，LLM 读取代码生成 PRD 和接口契约；重写上游测试使其独立于私有辅助函数和源代码布局；预期结果用标准库计算或独立进程计算；公开制品中识别信息被中和（但模型仍可能识别项目）。验证门控：环境必须能重建、参考实现必须通过完整套件、对抗性验证（注入缺陷/空洞实现/禁止捷径必须被拒绝），每轮验证最多 4 轮。（3）评估框架：cbrun 运行器分两阶段——solve 阶段代理在容器内工作，禁用代码托管站点、禁止安装上游包、提交后扫描拒绝导入上游实现；judge 阶段将工作区复制到独立离线容器注入隐藏测试，二元评分无 LLM 评判。

Result: 三个配置在 11 个任务上的结果：GPT-6 Astra (Codex) 解决 10/11 (90.9%)，耗时均值 14.4 分钟，成本 $47.04；Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) 解决 9/11 (81.8%)，19.7 分钟，$49.37；Grok 4.7 High (Cursor CLI) 解决 7/11 (63.6%)，51.5 分钟，$45.75。三个配置均完成提交，无超时或构建错误。GPT-6 Astra 仅在任务 009 (Go) 失败；Claude Opus 5.5 失败任务 006 和 009；Grok 4.7 High 额外失败任务 003 和 008。失败提交通过 89.9%-99.4% 的隐藏测试。失败模式分类（5 类）：尾部边缘规则、罕见子系统非功能、单点遗漏打破测试组、环境依赖行为、崩溃。随着能力提升，非功能子系统首先消失，然后是环境依赖行为，最后剩下尾部规则和单点不一致。任务 009 是唯一三个配置都失败的任务。语言结果：Python 任务 8/8、7/8、7/8（仅任务 006 在 Python 中失败）；非 Python 任务为 2/3、2/3、0/3。

Conclusion: Zero2Repo 衡量编码代理能否从产品规范和空目录交付在原生生态系统中运行的仓库。即使使用 11 个广为人知的仓库，基准也能区分当前前沿配置（GPT-6 Astra 10/11、Claude Opus 5.5 9/11、Grok 4.7 High 7/11），每个失败都可追溯到具体遗漏的规范规则。语言无关的构建流水线和验证门控使每个任务仅需 1-2 小时作者审核，可扩展至多语言。同一任务资产还可用于监督学习轨迹和强化学习环境。主要局限：规模仅 11 个任务（Python 8 个，其他语言各 1 个），种子项目过于知名可能使通过率偏高；每配置仅运行一次未测方差；仅测试三个前沿配置。未来计划扩展至 30-50 个任务、平衡语言分布、纳入近期发布仓库并周期性更新以应对训练数据污染。

Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly asked to build software rather than patch it, yet benchmarks for from-scratch repository construction are mostly limited to a single language and depend on manually curated tasks. We introduce Zero2Repo, a benchmark in which an agent receives a product requirements document, an interface contract, and an empty workspace, and must deliver a complete repository in the project's native ecosystem. Tasks are produced by a language-agnostic authoring pipeline that converts real, version-pinned open-source projects into behavioral specifications, reproducible environments, and hidden acceptance tests. Each task is validated by execution: a reference implementation derived from the upstream project must pass, and adversarial validation must show that the tests reject incorrect implementations. Evaluation runs production coding agents in isolated containers, withholds the acceptance tests until an explicit submission, and assigns a binary reward only when every test passes, with no LLM judge. The pipeline and harness make no language-specific assumptions and apply to mainstream programming ecosystems; the current release contains Python, TypeScript, Go, and C++ tasks. Even on 11 tasks drawn from repositories that frontier models have very likely seen during training, the strongest agent solves only 10, and every failing submission passes 90-99% of the hidden tests; for the two strongest agents, 67-100% of failed tests trace to a single omission or a low-frequency rule stated in the specification rather than to a missing subsystem, so each failure is a concrete target for improvement.

</details>


### [307] [E2E-SWE: Benchmarking LLMs on Building Working Codebases from Scratch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38335)
*Hantian Ding,Chloe Bi,Jiacheng Zhu,John Yang,Matt Deitke,Pengcheng Yin,Zijian Wang,Rui Hou*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出E2E-SWE基准测试，包含186个跨11种编程语言的全仓库生成任务，用于评估LLM智能体从自然语言规范和空工作区构建完整、可安装、可通过隐藏测试的软件仓库的能力。通过严格的测试驱动规范编写与多轮静态+回放审核修复机制保障任务可解性，13个前沿模型pass@1介于11.7%至67.7%，展现出强区分度且仍有较大提升空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM驱动的编码智能体从局部代码修改向全仓库开发演进，亟需一个能够衡量系统级规划与长时程执行能力的评测基准。然而现有基准（如SWE-bench、NL2Repo-Bench）普遍存在规范-测试不匹配、需求未充分说明等问题，导致低pass@1无法可靠反映模型真实能力，因此需要将"可解性"作为一等设计目标来构建新的全仓库生成评测。

Method: （1）任务构建：软件工程师与LLM协作，从真实GitHub仓库出发，从头编写测试套件与实现无关的规范，规范须经"测试驱动"反向推导；（2）任务格式：采用Harbor格式，包含instruction.md、tests/、solution/、task.toml，禁用网络访问，需输出setup.sh安装脚本；（3）质量精炼：两轮静态审核（测试质量、规范公平性）+回放引导审核（观察真实模型失败案例区分模型错误与任务缺陷），由修复智能体迭代修补；（4）评测：ReAct智能体骨架（含edit和submit工具），128K输出token上限，4小时时间预算，100万上下文与1000轮上限，主指标为pass@1（须全部隐藏测试通过）；（5）辅助分析：12-gram包含度衡量记忆化程度，LLM裁判归因失败原因。

Result: 13个前沿模型在E2E-SWE上pass@1从11.7%（Gemini 3.6 Flash）到67.7%（Claude Opus 5）分布广泛，区分度强；Claude Opus 5（67.7%）、Fable 5（65.3%）、GPT-5.6 Sol（61.2%）领先；推理努力从low到xhigh可显著提升pass@1，但xhigh到max趋于饱和；轨迹分析显示"前置长推理"模式——多数模型最长推理轮出现在前12轮内，部分在前4轮，峰值推理占比可达55.9%；生成代码量普遍少于参考仓库；记忆化分析显示Claude三款模型在24-30个任务上12-gram包含度超50%，但高包含度并不必然带来高通过率（增量-0.6至+9.6pp）；任务缺陷归因仅影响2.2%的整体结果；对照NL2Repo-Bench所有模型pass@1更低且集中在8-22%，区分度差。

Conclusion: E2E-SWE是首个以"可解性"为第一设计目标、跨多语言、覆盖完整仓库构建的评测基准，通过测试驱动的规范编写与多轮静态+回放审核修复，有效消除了规范-测试失配问题。实验证明其能清晰区分前沿模型的端到端仓库生成能力（11.7%-67.7%），任务缺陷影响极低（2.2%），且为长时程系统级软件工程能力提供了高难度但可度量的衡量标准，未来仍有显著提升空间。

Abstract: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are evolving from making localized code changes to developing complete software repositories. However, evaluating repository-scale generation remains challenging: tasks must demand system-level reasoning while ensuring that all evaluated behaviors are precisely specified and independent of any particular implementation. We introduce E2E-SWE, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can build complete, functional software repositories end to end. E2E-SWE contains 186 whole-repository generation tasks spanning 11 programming languages. Given only a natural-language specification and an empty workspace, an agent must implement a complete, installable project that satisfies a comprehensive suite of hidden tests. Each task is constructed by a software engineer in collaboration with an LLM; together, they develop the test suite and a corresponding implementation-independent specification. To ensure that tasks are well specified and practically solvable, we further subject them to an iterative verification process in which autonomous agents audit and repair task defects using static inspection and failures observed from real model rollouts. Evaluating 13 frontier models, we find substantial variation in end-to-end repository generation ability, with pass@1 ranging from 11.7% to 67.7%, providing strong model differentiation while leaving considerable headroom for future progress. Analysis of agent trajectories further reveals long, front-loaded reasoning patterns, highlighting the planning and system-level reasoning required to construct working codebases from scratch.

</details>


### [308] [OpenCollab: A Multi-Agent Coding Framework with Programmable Collaboration and Controllable Runtime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38345)
*Chun-Wah Hsu,Kai Gong,Yu Wu,Xianhe Chen,Mengyang Liu,Jie Li,Hanyu Li,Zhixuan Liu,Naisheng Tang,Jiaying Chi,Ziheng Fan,Xuning He,Xiaokang Yang,Xue Jiang,Yihong Dong*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: OpenCollab是一个多智能体编码框架，通过统一的基础设施实现可编程协作和可控运行时。它提出了Adherence指标来量化声明的组织结构是否真正被实现，并发现智能体在不同配置下的协作行为差异巨大（Adherence从47.2%到97.2%）。其两编码器工作流在多个主流基准测试上达到了SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体编码系统的评估假设配置的组织结构被忠实执行，但实际执行往往偏离声明；这种行为差距加上底层系统组件的差异，使得观察到的性能提升难以归因。本文旨在揭示并解决多智能体系统评估中的"协作幻觉"问题。

Method: OpenCollab采用解耦的两层架构：(1)基础层是共享会话运行时，包含十状态有限状态机，处理上下文管理、模型调用和工具执行；(2)编排层通过独立控制器（Team、Workflow、Single）管理会话拓扑、生命周期和消息路由。核心方法包括：(a)声明式协作规范（角色边界、通信拓扑）；(b)调用前准入控制（pre-call admission）强制执行预算和工具限制；(c)结构化事件流（替代散文日志）捕获每一步操作；(d)基于六个验证轴（参与度、委派、角色边界、预算共享、信息流、上下文策略）计算Adherence指标；(e)使用CACE（complier average causal effect）进行因果归因。

Result: (1)审计十个主流代理框架，发现没有一个满足所有七个受控评估条件，而OpenCollab满足全部；(2)单维度消融实验显示，改变任何单一维度都会使Adherence从47.2%变化到97.2%；强制约束（如只读工具）可将Adherence提升至90%以上；(3)跨框架比较中，OpenCollab (Duo)在SWE-bench Pro上达到64.25%、Terminal-Bench 2.1上达到83.15%、DeepSWE上达到69.91%的Pass@1，超过Mini-SWE-agent、Codex CLI和Claude Code；(4)OpenCollab (Base)在所有基准上使用最少token；(5)Duo相比Base在Terminal-Bench上+3.4点、DeepSWE上+14.2点；(6)案例分析显示，无约束配置下主导智能体常垄断预算而绕过队友。

Conclusion: OpenCollab通过解耦组织设计与执行机制，建立了统一的多智能体编程基础设施。Adherence指标揭示了声明与实际执行之间的"协作幻觉"，并证明通过适当的架构设计可以系统性地控制协作行为。结构化事件流和因果识别框架使研究者能够正确归因组织效应，避免因预算、工具或运行时差异导致的混杂。该工作强调：未验证协作是否发生的评估无法将性能提升归因于组织结构本身。

Abstract: Multi-agent coding systems are designed to tackle complex software engineering tasks through collaboration. However, existing evaluations typically assume configured organizations are followed faithfully, whereas reality differs. This behavioral gap, combined with differences in underlying system components, prevents clear attribution of observed gains. To this end, we introduce OpenCollab, a multi-agent coding framework that provides a unified infrastructure for programmable collaboration and controllable runtime. Specifically, OpenCollab unifies organization design, enforces experimental control on a shared runtime, and tracks execution through fine-grained event streams. On this basis, we define Adherence to quantify whether the declared organization is actually realized. Our experiments reveal that agents collaborate very differently across configurations: changing any single dimension shifts Adherence, from 47.2% to as high as 97.2%. Furthermore, extensive agentic coding benchmarks show that a two-coder workflow built on OpenCollab establishes new SOTA performance compared to the mainstream harnesses such as Mini-SWE-agent, Codex CLI, and Claude Code, showing that a well-designed organization can outperform strong existing harnesses, while OpenCollab's single-agent configuration uses the fewest tokens across all evaluated suites. OpenCollab establishes a unified multi-agent infrastructure for easy programmable collaboration and controlled causal evaluation.

</details>


### [309] [An Empirical Study of Architectural Shift from Traditional to AI-Enabled Simulink Controllers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38504)
*Hadiza Umar Yusuf,Khouloud Gaaloul*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文对Simulink中传统控制器与AI驱动控制器的架构差异进行了首次系统性实证研究。研究基于一个文献驱动的分类法（10个结构类别和9个功能角色），分析了62个真实Simulink模型（涵盖8种控制器和10个应用领域），并辅以13位从业者的问卷调查，揭示了三大架构张力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI组件（尤其是深度强化学习和神经网络）在信息物理系统（CPS）中逐渐取代基于数学推导的控制律，工程界缺乏对这些控制器架构差异的系统性理解。现有比较多关注行为结果（如性能、鲁棒性、安全违规率），而将架构视为隐含背景而非明确分析对象。这给安全关键领域的模型验证和追溯带来困难。

Method: 研究采用三阶段方法：(1) 通过系统的文献检索构建分类法，包含10个Simulink块结构类别（C1-C10）和9个功能角色（L1-L9）；(2) 对62个真实Simulink模型进行块级提取和分类，使用覆盖率（Coverage）、平均归一化存在度（MNP）和模型级流行度（MLP）三种度量；(3) 对13位有控制器设计经验的从业者开展问卷调查，让其对12个代表性模型进行人工评估。

Result: 研究发现三大架构张力：(1) 子系统组织（C6）在两种范式中均占据主导地位，占控制器结构的68-72%，而核心控制逻辑仅占极小空间；(2) AI驱动控制器严重依赖离散动力学（C2）和用户定义抽象（C8），这些类别在AI文献中几乎未被描述，暴露出文献与实现的不一致；(4) 约束执行块（C3）从AI驱动模型中消失，但从业者仍期望它们存在，表明安全机制从显式结构转移到隐式训练时工件，破坏了可追溯性。

Conclusion: 该研究建立了跨范式架构比较的首个实证基线。研究建议MBSE工具支持应：(1) 将脚手架（scaffolding）作为可重用的首要抽象，而非临时拼凑；(2) 将AI驱动控制器中的奖励塑形、惩罚和环境设计决策表示为显式可检查的工件，弥补安全约束从结构到训练时的迁移带来的追溯性差距。未来工作应设计和验证此类工具支持。

Abstract: Effective AI adoption in cyber-physical systems (CPS) depends on embedding design knowledge into engineering practice. Yet as AI-enabled components increasingly replace analytically derived control laws, this occurs without a systematic understanding of how controller architectures differ or remain similar across paradigms. We address this gap with an empirical study of traditional and AI-enabled Simulink controllers, guided by a literature-derived taxonomy of ten structural categories and nine functional roles. The study analyzes 62 real-world models spanning 8 controller types and 10 application domains, and surveys 13 practitioners, identifying three architectural tensions. First, subsystem organization dominates all controller structures regardless of paradigm, occupying 68-72% of controller footprint, while core control logic occupies minimal space. Second, AI-enabled controllers rely heavily on discrete dynamics and user-defined abstraction, categories largely absent from AI literature, exposing a gap between described and implemented architectures. Third, constraint enforcement blocks largely disappear from AI-enabled models despite practitioner expectations. This reveals a misalignment where safety mechanisms shift from explicit structure to implicit training-time artifacts, breaking traceability.

</details>


### [310] [Adaptive-GEPA: Make Your Harness Fit Heterogeneous Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38762)
*Tianyu Chen,Yasi Zhang,Ruiyi Wang,Xinran Zhao,Taoran Li,Mingyuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Adaptive-GEPA 提出了一种联合优化路由器与专家程序库的搜索方法，能够在单一搜索预算下同时学习如何划分异构请求以及如何求解它们，在固定四类任务混合负载上显著优于单一程序优化基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一语言模型服务常需处理需要不同工具、推理模式和控制流的异构请求；现有方法要么优化一个共享程序（将任务分工隐式编码在源码搜索中），要么预先按任务族划分独立优化（无法联合发现任务划分），因此需要一种能同时学习请求划分与求解方案的统一框架。

Method: 将系统表示为路由提示 R + 一组带自然语言描述 d_k、可执行程序 M_k 与激活位 z_k 的专家槽位。反射模型先根据反馈轨迹选择动作（激活专家、改写程序、改写描述、改写路由器、停用槽位），再针对目标源进行编辑。合并不同分支时，通过各专家在验证集上实际处理的请求集合（footprint）计算 Jaccard 重叠进行相互最佳匹配，使描述与程序作为原子单元共同继承，冲突时按共享请求上的得分择优。保留 GEPA 的逐请求 Pareto 选择与反射编辑框架。

Result: 在 Qwen3-8B + GPT-5.5 反射、四任务族（HotpotQA/AIME/PUPA/LiveBench-IF）混合负载、约 18,000 次评分调用预算下，Adaptive-GEPA 家族均值（×100）从种子 52.6 提升至 70.6，高于 GEPA-FPA-ALL 的 62.5 与 GRPO 的 54.0，接近带标签路由参考 73.0；路由器在全部 651 条测试请求上后验对齐任务划分。GPT-4.1 执行器下结果一致（71.5 vs 69.8）。同时分析了专家专门化、合并效果与局部编辑分布。

Conclusion: 将请求划分纳入程序优化是可行的：通过联合进化路由器、专家描述与可执行程序，并以请求足迹对齐方式继承跨分支组件，可在固定异构负载下逼近带标签独立优化的参考水平，显著优于单一共享程序与 RL 微调基线。但结果基于单一主种子，存在评估局限（验证集重复使用、PUPA 评分激励、GPT-4.1 运行受中断影响），未涵盖在线任务发现、鲁棒性与组件消融。

Abstract: Reflective optimizers such as GEPA improve language model prompts from execution traces and evaluator feedback; full-program extensions can also rewrite tools and control flow. In practice, a user hands the same endpoint heterogeneous requests whose effective solutions require different tools, reasoning modes, and control flow. Optimizing one shared program leaves this division of work implicit in source-code search, while optimizing a separate program per request family fixes it beforehand. We introduce Adaptive-GEPA, which learns both how to divide requests and how to solve them. It evolves a router and a library of specialist programs under one search budget. The router's instructions, each specialist's description, and its program code are plain, human-readable text, edited from feedback. To combine branches, it aligns specialists by the requests they handle and inherits descriptions together with programs. On a fixed mixture of four task families, the reported Qwen3-8B run evolves four experts without supplying family labels to the router or reflection model; its routing matches the task partition on all 651 test requests. Its family-mean test score (x100) rises from 52.6 to 70.6, compared with 62.5 for GEPA's full-program adapter and 54.0 for GRPO at a nominal budget of 18,000 scored calls. These counts do not equate total compute. Figure 1 summarizes the learning curves, final test scores, and routing agreement.

</details>


### [311] [From Verification Failures to Reusable Guidance for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39022)
*Yuqing Zhai,Xiaohong Chen,Lingming Zhang,Sriram Vishwanath,Grigore Rosu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究如何将专家诊断验证失败的经验转化为可复用的指导，以帮助编码智能体生成附带可验证正确性论证的程序。作者结合K框架的可执行语言定义与一套构造规约、修复证明、审查充分性的程序工具包（kit），在HumanEval的164个Python任务上实现了164/164的成功率，并探讨了审计、规约构建及智能合约验证中的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型生成的程序仍存在错误，而推理程序执行对其而言仍然困难。形式化验证能检查性质是否成立，但智能体还需确保规约本身覆盖了所请求的行为。论文的核心动机在于：将专家诊断验证失败的经验（如不变量不匹配、规约范围过窄等）沉淀为可复用的程序性指导，从而在推理时帮助后续智能体避免重复犯错，提升验证工作的可靠性与可复用性。

Method: 方法包括四个核心组件：(1) 使用K框架定义可执行的操作语义，支撑具体执行与符号证明；(2) 构建一个"验证工具包"（kit），含构造规约、构建证明、审查充分性的程序，每个程序附适用条件与检查示例；(3) 采用HumanEval的人导开发流程，结合K做程序推理、Lean处理残余数学义务、Z3处理领域蕴含；(4) 使用KleverBench（含12个干净/缺陷对、31个运算符含义互换的程序）在GPT-5.6 Luna与DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash两种模型/预算设置下对比完整接受规则、通用建议与kit核心的效果，并附加Optimism智能合约的EVM/London语义人工审查验证。

Result: 主要结果：(1) HumanEval 164个Python任务经两次定向修复后，最终AI审计全部判为Pass，实现164/164成功率；(2) 12对作者审核的干净/缺陷包审计中，K证明全部通过，但完成的审计能识别12/12缺陷、接受12/12干净包（95% Wilson区间75.8–100%）；(3) KleverBench上GPT-5.6 Luna的接受率分别为15/31、15/31、19/31，DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash为17/31、18/31、16/31；所有配对kit效应区间包含零，结果混合；(4) Optimism智能合约六项操作的暂停回退在London语义与无界gas下的输入界限内经人工审查验证成立。

Conclusion: 论文得出结论：将专家验证经验编码为共享语义与可复用程序工具包，配合形式化审计，可帮助编码智能体交付附带可验证正确性论证的程序。HumanEval实验证明了端到端可行性，审计能发现成功证明遗漏的问题。然而KleverBench上的混合结果表明，在资源受限条件下如何选择有用的指导仍是未解决问题，需要进一步研究程序选择与指导使用成本之间的权衡。论文报告了进展、困难与教训，为后续智能体提供附带可检查正确性论证的程序这一方向奠定基础。

Abstract: Coding agents need to establish that a program satisfies a specification and that the specification captures the requested behavior. We study how expert diagnosis of verification failures can become reusable guidance for this work. Our approach combines executable language definitions in the K framework with a kit of procedures for constructing specifications, repairing proofs, and auditing their adequacy. A human-guided development campaign on HumanEval, a benchmark of 164 Python programming tasks, achieves a 164/164 success rate with the semantics and the kit, measured by final AI audit Pass verdicts after two targeted repairs.
